Key Responsibilities 

This position is designed as a cross-functional revenue integrity role. While primary responsibilities focus on clinical and DRG appeals, the specialist is expected to support DRG validation audits, coding compliance reviews, clinical validation initiatives, and denial-prevention activities during periods of lower appeals volume. Flexibility and the ability to work across multiple revenue cycle disciplines are essential requirements of the position. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Review denied claims involving DRG downgrades, clinical validation and coding denials. 

  • Conduct a comprehensive analysis of medical records, coded data, physician documentation, laboratory results, imaging findings, treatments, and patient outcomes to identify appeal opportunities. 

  • Draft clear, persuasive, evidence-based appeal letters using clinical indicators, coding guidelines, payer policies, Coding Clinic guidance, and CMS regulations. 

  • Prepare first-level and second-level appeals and reconsideration requests for commercial, Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid payers. 

  • Defend the clinical validity of diagnoses commonly targeted by payers, including sepsis, acute respiratory failure, acute kidney injury, malnutrition, encephalopathy, and other MCC/CC conditions, using evidence-based practice and literature. 

  • Validate coding accuracy, DRG assignment, principal diagnosis selection, present-on-admission indicators, and reimbursement determinations. 

  • Research and incorporate peer-reviewed clinical literature, specialty society guidance, and regulatory references to support appeal positions. 

  • Track appeal outcomes, recovered revenue, overturn rates, and denial trends for reporting and continuous improvement. 

  • Participate in client education initiatives focused on denial prevention, documentation improvement, and coding accuracy. 

  • Maintain productivity during fluctuations in denial volume by independently conducting DRG audits, coding compliance reviews, clinical validation assessments, pre-bill revenue integrity reviews, and denial-prevention initiatives to support organizational revenue cycle objectives 

 

Qualifications 

Education and Experience 

  • Current RN license or professional coding credential required. 

  • Bachelor’s degree in nursing, Health Information Management, or a related healthcare field preferred. 

  • Minimum of five years of experience in Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI), inpatient coding, denials management, clinical validation, DRG validation, or revenue cycle operations. 

  • Minimum of three years of experience writing successful payer appeals preferred. 

  • Experience reviewing Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, RAC, and commercial insurance denials. 

  • Demonstrated experience working with electronic health record (EHR) systems and encoder applications.

jobs.title: Cardata: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada
URL: https://l.cardata.co/linkedin

Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

Customer Success Manager 

At Cardata, customers are at the centre of everything we do. Our Customer Success team protects retention by helping customers get greater value from their reimbursement programs and building strong, lasting relationships.

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a portfolio of customer relationships after implementation, helping customers navigate their programs, resolve challenges, and achieve meaningful business outcomes while contributing to Cardata's GRR and NRR goals.

This is a hands-on role that combines customer relationship management with problem-solving and day-to-day execution and management of customer expectations. You'll develop a strong understanding of our platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently investigate issues, troubleshoot challenges, and guide customers toward practical solutions.

You'll thrive here if you're naturally curious and enjoy learning, are resourceful, highly organized, and an excellent communicator. You enjoy digging into complex problems, finding answers, and balancing competing priorities while ensuring customers feel supported and nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a remote-first role with occasional travel, approximately 2–3 times per quarter.

What you'll do

  • Own a portfolio of customer relationships, understanding their business objectives, reimbursement programs, and ongoing needs to deliver a responsive, reliable customer experience while managing customer expectations.
  • Investigate and resolve customer challenges, using platform knowledge, documentation, data, and internal resources to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and drive solutions through to completion.
  • Manage a high volume of customer requests, triaging inquiries, prioritizing by urgency and business impact, and maintaining clear ownership of deadlines and follow-ups and managing customer expectations.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively, setting expectations, explaining complex information, and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.
  • Develop deep knowledge of Cardata's platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently answer questions, guide customers, and identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness.
  • Monitor customer health, adoption, and program performance, identifying risks and taking action to protect retention and customer satisfaction.
  • Lead customer check-ins, and renewal preparation, using customer insights to demonstrate value and provide practical recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes and expand value, partnering with Account Managers on potential growth opportunities.
  • With support of Customer Success Associate, interpret data insights to inform customer conversations and recommendations.
  • Partner with Support, Product, Engineering, and Implementation to coordinate resolutions, address recurring issues, and improve the customer experience.

What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Implementation, or a similar customer-facing role, within B2B SaaS.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the curiosity and resourcefulness to investigate unfamiliar issues, identify root causes, and independently drive resolution.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information, manage stakeholder expectations, and navigate challenging customer conversations.
  • Excellent organization, prioritization, and time management skills, with experience managing a busy portfolio, high volumes of inquiries, and competing deadlines.
  • Strong customer ownership and relationship-building skills, with a track record of building trust, following through on commitments, and delivering a reliable customer experience.
  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn SaaS platforms, understand operational workflows, and navigate interconnected systems.
  • Sound judgment and attention to detail, particularly when assessing urgency, investigating issues, and determining when to involve internal partners.
  • Strong ability to recognize customer risks, protect retention, and identify opportunities for account growth.
  • Strong affinity for continual learning of new tools, products and programs.

Compensation

The expected base compensation for this role is 68,000–76,000 CAD annually, dependent on experience and competency. This role is also eligible for target variable incentives of 5,000-10,000 CAD, with actual earnings dependent on experience, skills, and performance.

This is a vacant position, and we are seeking someone who will bring a new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)
  • Extended medical & dental benefits
  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.

Cardata is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates will be equally considered without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, language, citizenship, creed, religion, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, physical and/or mental handicap or financial ability. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to bring their authentic selves to work.

If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: ComPsych Corporation: مستشار توجيه (Guidance Consultant)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United Arab Emirates
URL: http://www.compsych.com

About ComPsych

تُعد شركة ComPsych® Corporation أكبر مزود عالمي لخدمات الصحة النفسية وبرامج GuidanceResources® للحياة. وانطلاقاً من التزامها الراسخ بالابتكار المتواصل وتبنيها لنهج شامل في تقديم الرعاية، توفر ComPsych خدماتها لأكثر من 163 مليون فرد موزعين على 200 دولة. وتحت مظلة علامتنا التجارية GuidanceResources®، نقدم برامج مخصصة ومتكاملة تماماً تشمل مجالات الصحة السلوكية، وإدارة حالات الغياب، ومسارات العافية؛ وهي برامج تهدف إلى تمكين الموظفين من عيش حياة أكثر صحة وإنتاجية، فضلاً عن تعزيز التميز المؤسسي. تفضل بزيارة موقع compsych.com لتكتشف الأسباب التي دفعت 40% من الشركات المدرجة ضمن قائمة "Fortune 500" لاختيار ComPsych لتلبية احتياجاتها المتعلقة بالصحة النفسية.

 

 

ComPsych® Corporation is the world’s largest provider of mental health services and GuidanceResources® for life. Fueled by a commitment to relentless innovation and a comprehensive approach to care, ComPsych provides services to more than 163 million individuals across 200 countries. Under our GuidanceResources® brand, our personalized and fully integrated programs include behavioral health, absence, and wellness journeys, which empower employees to lead healthier and more productive lives, while driving organizational excellence. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health needs.

About the Role

 

المسمى الوظيفي هو "استشاري توجيه" (Guidance Consultant)، وهي وظيفة تعتمد نظام العمل عن بُعد ومقرها دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة. تُعد هذه الوظيفة عقداً محدد المدة وبدوام كامل، وهي مثالية للمتخصصين في مجال الصحة النفسية ممن يقدّرون التميز السريري ويتحلون بالتعاطف في نهجهم المهني، فضلاً عن قدرتهم على النجاح والتميز في بيئة عمل سريعة الإيقاع تضع سهولة الوصول وسرعة الاستجابة والرعاية المتمحورة حول العميل في

 

يقوم مستشارو التوجيه بتقديم دعم مباشر للعملاء عبر الهاتف والمحادثات النصية، حيث يتناولون القضايا المتعلقة بالصحة السلوكية، والرفاه العاطفي، والشؤون الأسرية، ومسائل العافية الشاملة؛ وذلك بمنتهى الاحترافية والتعاطف، وبالاستناد إلى حكم سريري سديد.

 

وبصفتها جزءاً من أكبر جهة مزودة في العالم لـ "برامج مساعدة الموظفين" (EAP) وخدمات الرعاية المُدارة للصحة السلوكية، فإن هذه الوظيفة تتيح فرصة استثنائية للنمو المهني. إذ يوظف المستشارون خبراتهم السريرية لتقديم الدعم الفوري في لحظة الحاجة، وتوجيه العملاء نحو الموارد المتاحة، وتسهيل إجراء الإحالات المناسبة وفي الوقت المناسب، لضمان استمرارية الرعاية وتحقيق نتائج إيجابية.

 

 

 

The job title is Guidance Consultant and is a remote working role residing in the country of United Arab Emirates. This is a Fixed-Term, Full-Time position and is ideal for mental health professionals who value clinical excellence and lead with empathy, and who thrive in a fast-paced environment where access, responsiveness, and client-centered care are essential.

 

Guidance Consultants provide direct client support via telephone and chat, addressing behavioral health, emotional well-being, family concerns, and overall wellness-related issues with professionalism, compassion, and sound clinical judgment.

 

As part of the world’s largest provider of Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and managed behavioral health care services, this role offers an exceptional opportunity for professional growth. Consultants leverage their clinical expertise to deliver in-the-moment support, guide clients through available resources, and facilitate timely, appropriate referrals to ensure continuity of care and positive outcomes.

 

What You'll Do

تقديم الدعم عبر الهاتف والمحادثة النصية من خلال إجراء تقييمات سريرية أولية شاملة، وإحالة العملاء إلى الموارد المناسبة، بما في ذلك المعالجون النفسيون، والمرشدون، وموارد العافية ذات الصلة.

 إجراء تقييمات للعملاء وتطبيق منهجيات التدريب (Coaching) لتطوير استراتيجيات مخصصة للصحة والعافية تدعم إحداث تغيير إيجابي في السلوك.

 ضمان الالتزام ببروتوكولات القسم، وأفضل الممارسات المتبعة في القطاع، والمتطلبات الخاصة بالعملاء؛ وذلك للحفاظ على الامتثال التنظيمي وضمان تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة.

 تقديم الخدمات بأسلوب يتسم بالكفاءة الثقافية، والشمولية، والاحترام للأفراد من خلفيات متنوعة وذوي احتياجات متباينة.

 توظيف التقدير السليم للمواقف، والتفكير النقدي، ومهارات حل المشكلات لتقييم الحالات، ومعالجة الشواغل بسرعة، وتسهيل تقديم الدعم المناسب لتعزيز تجربة العميل الشاملة.

 توعية العملاء بالموارد المتاحة، ومعايير الأهلية، والخدمات التي يقدمها البرنامج بأسلوب مهني ومتعاطف.

 الحفاظ على توثيق دقيق وشامل وفي الوقت المناسب لجميع التفاعلات مع العملاء ضمن نظام قاعدة البيانات الخاص بالمؤسسة.

 البقاء على اطلاع دائم بأحدث الاتجاهات والموارد وأفضل الممارسات الناشئة في مجال الصحة السلوكية، وذلك لتعزيز جودة تقديم الخدمات بشكل مستمر.

 التعاون مع الأطراف المعنية (أصحاب المصلحة) داخل المؤسسة وخارجها لضمان استمرارية الرعاية ومواءمة الخدمات مع التوقعات المحددة لكل عميل.

الالتزام الصارم بالسرية الطبية ولوائح حماية البيانات المعمول بها (مثل: GDPR في أوروبا، وPDPA في سنغافورة، وPIPEDA في كندا، وPDPL في الإمارات العربية المتحدة).

 أداء أي مهام إضافية أخرى تُسند إليه.

 

 

  • Provide telephonic and chat support by conducting comprehensive clinical intakes and referring clients to appropriate resources, including therapists, counselors and relevant wellness resources.
  • Conduct client assessments and apply coaching methodologies to develop tailored health and well-being strategies that support positive behavior change
  • Ensure adherence to departmental protocols, industry best practices, and customer-specific requirements to maintain compliance and high-quality service delivery.
  • Deliver services in a culturally competent, inclusive, and respectful manner to individuals from diverse backgrounds with varying needs.
  • Apply sound judgment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to assess situations, resolve concerns promptly, and facilitate appropriate support to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Educate clients regarding available resources, eligibility criteria, and program services in a professional and empathetic manner.
  • Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely documentation of all client interactions within the organization’s proprietary database system.
  • Stay informed on emerging behavioral health trends, resources, and best practices to continuously enhance service delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure continuity of care and alignment with client-specific service expectations.
  • Maintain strict adherence to medical confidentiality and applicable data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR in Europe, PDPA in Singapore, PIPEDA in Canada, PDPL in UAE)
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

 يُشترط الحصول على درجة الماجستير أو ما يعادلها من مؤهلات الدراسات العليا في علم النفس، أو الخدمة الاجتماعية، أو الصحة السلوكية، أو أي مجال ذي صلة بالصحة السلوكية من مؤسسة معترف بها.

 في حال كان الإطار التنظيمي المهني المعمول به في بلد أو ولاية العمل يعترف بشهادة البكالوريوس كمعيار أساسي للالتحاق بالتخصص ذي الصلة، يُمكن اعتبار هذه الشهادة من مؤسسة معترف بها، بالإضافة إلى الخبرة العملية ذات الصلة بعد الحصول عليها، معادلةً لها.

 يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة لممارسة المهنة و/أو الحصول على الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثما يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة للتأهل للممارسة المهنية و/أو الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثم

  يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

 الأهلية لممارسة المهنة و/أو التسجيل في بلد الإقامة وفقًا للوائح الوطنية

 إجادة استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس وأنظمة معلومات العملاء

 إجادة اللغتين الإنجليزية والعربية (لغة الإمارات العربية المتحدة)

 يُفضل الحصول على شهادات معترف بها في مجال التدريب الصحي أو العافية

 يُفضل الخبرة في العمل ضمن بيئات متعددة الثقافات أو دولية

jobs.title: MedAmerica: Instructional Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Sacramento, California, United States
URL: https://www.vituity.com/about-us/practice-management

Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Instructional Designer

 

Everybody Has A Role To Play In Transforming Healthcare

 

At Vituity you are part of a larger team that is driven by our purpose to improve lives. We are dedicated to transforming healthcare through our culture by working together to tackle healthcare’s most pressing challenges from the inside.

 

Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

 

Vituity Locations: Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

 

The Opportunity

  • Designs and develops engaging, accessible, learner-centered learning solutions that support enterprise education, organizational initiatives, knowledge transfer, and performance.
  • Conducts learning and performance analyses to identify audience needs, desired performance, root causes, skill gaps, and appropriate learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Develops and customizes learning across modalities, including eLearning, instructor-led and virtual learning, blended programs, job aid, microlearning, simulations, assessments, video, communications, and other performance-support resources.
  • Translates complex content into clear, accurate, engaging, and learner-centered experiences through research and collaboration with SMEs and stakeholders.
  • Develops measurable learning objectives, instructional strategies, storyboards, scripts, prototypes, practice activities, assessments, and evaluation approaches aligned to intended performance outcomes.
  • Applies instructional design and adult-learning principles, learning science, usability, accessibility, content governance, brand/design standards; uses approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, design, development, and quality assurance.
  • Conducts quality assurance and user testing to identify and resolve content, accessibility, usability, and functionality issues before implementation.
  • Creates and edits multimedia assets and refreshes, improves, or retires learning assets based on feedback, data, content changes, and business needs.
  • Shares design approaches, tools, lessons learned, and work in progress to support team learning and consistency.
  • Participates in peer reviews and provides timely, constructive, and actionable feedback; seeks and incorporates feedback on their own work.
  • Applies established instructional design standards and contributes recommendations to improve templates, guidance, workflows, and best practices.
  • Independently manages assigned learning projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, stakeholder reviews, approvals, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
  • Balances multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining quality, responsiveness, and alignment with agreed-upon requirements.
  • Identifies opportunities to improve learning experiences, development processes, tools, templates, and team workflows.
  • Evaluates and uses approved learning technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency, and learner experience.
  • Contributes instructional design and digital-content expertise to pilots, cross-functional projects, technology testing, and improvement initiatives within assigned scope.
  • Partners with SMEs and stakeholders to clarify performance needs, desired outcomes, audience requirements, and project expectations.
  • Recommends appropriate learning, performance support, or non-training solutions based on identified needs and constraints.
  • Provides guidance on learning strategy, modality selection, learner experience, accessibility, and implementation considerations.
  • Communicates recommendations, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  • Builds productive relationships with internal partners and represents Learning & Development professionally.
  • May manage solely, or in partnership with the LMS Administrator, including but not limited to: uploading, testing, updating, maintaining, and retiring courses and curricula in accordance with established standards and processes.
  • Troubleshoots course-level Learning Management System (LMS) issues related to functionality, navigation, tracking, completion, and learner experience; supports testing of Learning Management System (LMS) updates and features and escalate system-level issues to the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator as appropriate.
  • Partners with the Learning Management System (LMS) Administrator and stakeholders to support learner assignments and course delivery and develops or maintains SOPs and documentation related to instructional design processes and Learning Management System (LMS) interactions as needed.

 

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, business, communications, or a related field required OR an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in instructional design or learning content development, with related experience in areas such as technical writing/editing, digital content, multimedia development, or content governance required.
  • Experience applying one or more of the following: adult-learning theory, learning science, instructional design principles, and fit-for-purpose methodologies—such as ADDIE, SAM, and backward design—throughout the learning-development lifecycle required.
  • Experience conducting learning and performance needs analyses; defining measurable learning objectives; recommending appropriate learning or performance-support solutions; and evaluating learning effectiveness required.
  • Experience designing and developing engaging, accessible learning experiences across multiple modalities, including e-learning, instructor-led or virtual instructor-led training, job aids, performance-support resources, and interactive multimedia required.
  • Experience partnering with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to gather requirements, translate complex information into clear and actionable learning content, incorporate feedback, and move projects through review and approval required.
  • Experience managing learning projects from planning through implementation, including scope, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder communication, and competing priorities required.
  • Experience working with a Learning Management System (LMS), including uploading and managing content, supporting course assignments, tracking learner completion, and assisting with course administration required.
  • Proficient in Articulate 360, including Storyline and Rise, with the ability to develop, update, test, and troubleshoot interactive digital learning content required.
  • Working knowledge of – and ability to apply – accessible and inclusive learning-design principles and applicable standards, including captions, alternative text, color contrast, keyboard accessibility, and accessible documents required.
  • Experience applying WCAG and accessibility standards to e-learning and digital learning content preferred.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud or comparable digital-media editing tools preferred.
  • Experience using learning analytics, learner feedback, assessment data, or performance data to improve learning solutions
  • Experience with learning platform reporting, course lifecycle management, or LMS quality assurance preferred.
  • Portfolio demonstrates learner-centered, accessible learning solutions across more than one modality preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of adult-learning principles, instructional design methodologies, learner-experience design, learning science, and performance-based learning.
  • Ability to analyze business, performance, and learning needs; identify root causes; determine when training is appropriate; and recommend practical learning or performance-support solutions.
  • Ability to translate complex, technical, or specialized information into clear, concise, engaging, and learner-centered content for varied audiences.
  • Ability to develop measurable learning objectives and align instructional strategies, content, practice, assessments, and evaluation methods with desired learning and performance outcomes.
  • Ability to design accessible and inclusive learning experiences by applying applicable accessibility standards and best practices across learning content and digital media.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, including managing multiple projects and priorities, establishing timelines, coordinating reviews, identifying risks and dependencies, communicating status, and meeting established deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration, consultation, and communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with SMEs, stakeholders, and team members; facilitate productive discussions; incorporate feedback; and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Proficiency with LMS, multimedia, collaboration, documentation, project-management, and productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 applications such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to use learner feedback, assessment results, stakeholder input, and available learning and performance data to evaluate effectiveness and continuously improve learning solutions.
  • Demonstrates the judgement, validation, confidentiality, and human-review practices required for responsible use.
  • Ability to work independently with initiative and sound judgment while contributing to a collaborative team environment through knowledge sharing, peer review, constructive feedback, and continuous improvement.

 

The Community

Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.

  • Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
  • Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
  • Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
  • Flexible work hours
  • Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

 

Benefits & Beyond*

Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.

  • Superior health plan options
  • Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D coverage, and more
  • Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6%25 plus discretionary profit-sharing contributions (eligible January following 18 months of service)
  • Generous paid time off starting 3-4 weeks’ annually
  • Student Loan Refinancing Discounts
  • Professional and Career Development Program
  • EAP and travel assistance included
  • Wellness program
  • Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees

 

 

We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $64,970 - $81,215, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.

 

We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across sites and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.

 

Vituity does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. Vituity is committed to complying with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

 

*Benefits for part-time and per diem vary. Please speak to a recruiter for more information.

 

Applicants only. No agencies please.

About the Role

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.

  • QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.
  • Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.
  • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

Preferred

  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. jobs.title: Samsara: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://www.samsara.com/

About the role:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
  • You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
  • You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
  • You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
  • You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

  • Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
  • Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
  • Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.
  • Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.
  • Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
  • Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.
  • Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
  • Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
  • Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.
  • Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
  • A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
  • Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$162,400—$290,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Are you looking for a cutting-edge tech stack to work with daily? We are currently expanding our Infrastructure team and are looking for a new colleague to join as a Staff DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer. You can work from home or one of our Central Europe offices (Bratislava, Brno, Prague) on a full-time basis. The base salary range for this position is 1 520 000 - 1 900 000 CZK. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Are you ready to grow with us?

What tech stack do we have for you?

  • Kubernetes (GKE), Terraform, GitLab
  • Google Cloud, including a wide range of managed products such as Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub
  • Self-hosted stack: MongoDB, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Etcd, Victoria Metrics, InfluxDB, Sentry
  • Python, Golang

Minimum requirements:

At least 5 years of production experience with:

  • Kubernetes - we are looking for an engineer who not only deploys applications to a cluster, but also understands what is happening behind the scenes and can operate 24x7 production
  • GCP (preferred)/AWS/Azure - our solution is built on top of the GCP platform. Candidate should be comfortable working with public cloud, understand the risks and benefits associated with running applications in the public cloud, be familiar with infrastructure as a code principle, and have the ability to make design choices between using cloud-managed solutions versus self-hosted alternatives
  • Python/Go - you should be able to read and understand code with confidence, and to review and evaluate AI-generated Python code for correctness, security, and fit. Hands-on coding skills matter less than before, but you should still be able to develop custom tooling when needed, with or without AI assistance

 

If you don’t meet these requirements, don’t worry; take a look at the Senior DevOps position - Czechia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329244, Slovakia: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/bloomreach/jobs/8329243

 

How to know if you are a good fit:

The qualifications outlined below serve as a guide to determine if your skills and experience align with the requirements of this position:

  • Design and Specification: You turn loosely defined problems into designs and specifications that others can execute. You write design proposals, weigh trade-offs between managed and self-hosted solutions, and review the designs of others.
  • Cross-team Leadership: You have led projects spanning multiple teams, from scoping and planning through delivery, coordinating engineers who do not report to you.
  • Independent Delivery: You take a specified maintenance or project task and drive it to completion on your own. AI assistants are a given part of your toolkit, but you always understand and can explain how and why every change was made.
  • AI as a Tool, Not a Replacement: You use AI assistants to work faster, not to hand your work over. You understand what the AI produced, question and verify it, and steer it toward the outcome you want rather than accepting whatever it gives you. You stay in control and remain accountable for everything you ship.
  • Continuous Learning: You have a keen interest in Kubernetes and related technologies, as demonstrated by your active engagement in reading and staying up to date on them.
  • Conference Participation: You have participated in DevOps-related conferences, showcasing your commitment to continuous learning and networking in the field.
  • Configuration Proficiency: You have hands-on experience configuring pod/container security context, network policies, roles and role bindings, pod affinity, host path, pod disruption budgets, priority classes, node taints, to name a few.
  • Resource Optimization: You have analyzed resource usage of applications hosted on a cluster and implemented or suggested changes to resource requests/limits, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPAs), or Vertical Pod Autoscalers (VPAs).
  • Cluster Management: You have a deep understanding of the clusters you manage, including the types of machines used in node pools, the reasons for their selection, which cluster features are enabled or disabled, the cluster version, and the node autoscaling configuration. You have successfully upgraded the Kubernetes cluster versions without interrupting live applications hosted on the cluster.

The Infrastructure team operates and maintains Bloomreach Engagement core infrastructure built on Google Cloud with security, high availability, costs, and scalability in mind. Our vision is to identify and implement opportunities to achieve a robust, reliable, and efficient infrastructure and development platform. We strongly support DevOps culture: each team is responsible for releasing, operating, and monitoring their own applications.

The role of the Infrastructure Team is to provide a strong foundation upon which all teams can build, for example, manage big infrastructure components like Kubernetes, databases, and cloud components in Google Cloud. An important role of the team is also to provide support to developers, review design proposals, validate the performance and availability of applications, and sometimes even develop new core application components such as logging or authorization.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;

Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals.   • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;

Here at Hometap, we’re collaborative, passionate, and always ready to roll up our sleeves to create solutions that help people get more out of homeownership — and out of life. Our first product, a home equity investment, gives homeowners the opportunity to quickly access the equity they’ve built in their home to pay for what’s most important to them, from handling debt to finally making much-needed renovations, without taking on debt.

You'll analyze a broad set of home and homeowner information to assess the risk profile of each application and make investment eligibility recommendations against the standards in our underwriting guidelines. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, giving you a real stake in the company’s growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

Our home equity investment product provides homeowners with a fast, simple, and straightforward way to access the equity in their home without taking out a loan or having to sell. By investing alongside homeowners, Hometap offers debt-free cash in exchange for a share of their home’s future value — all without any monthly payments over the life of the investment. Through a combination of financial innovation and best-in-class customer service, Hometap enables people to get more from homeownership so they can get more from life.
 
Hometap believes that our differences are what bring us together, and one of our biggest priorities is creating a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member’s unique perspective, background, and ideas. Remuneration is through Wise (wise.com), monthly, between the 10th and the 12th of the month.

Applicant Requirements

  • Logical, able to explain concepts clearly and simply

  • Positive attitude

Technology Requirements

  • Modern, reliable computer (~10,000+ on www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu_list.php)

Application Process

· A link to your introduction video (Vimeo, YouTube, Google, or other safe platforms). The video can be 1-2 minutes in length, telling us a bit about your education and teaching background. If you send us a video file instead of a link, please make sure it is smaller than 20MB.

Please understand that due to the high volume of applications, we are only able to consider applicants who submit all the information listed above. Thank you for your interest in JadeClass Education!

jobs.title: DeepSeas: Lead Incident Response Analyst
jobs.description:
Headquarters: California, United States
URL: https://deepseas.com

DeepSeas owns cyber risk for its clients: autonomously, continuously, and with proof. The company brings security technology, threat intelligence, and expert practitioners together to deliver coordinated cyber defense, helping organizations strengthen protection while reducing the work required of their internal teams.

Combining agentic AI with human judgment, DeepSeas automates threat analysis and response within client-defined boundaries, continuously improves defenses through threat hunting and detection engineering, and provides visibility into investigations, actions taken, and service performance. Its technology-agnostic approach works with the security investments clients already have.

DeepSeas connects 24/7 managed detection and response with offensive security, vulnerability management, governance, risk and compliance, CISO advisory, and incident response. With 30 years of experience in cyber defense.

DeepSeas is trusted by nearly 1,000 clients around the world, including Fortune 100 enterprises and mid-market organizations. Its team of more than 250 cybersecurity professionals serves clients across 30+ countries.

Frost & Sullivan recognized DeepSeas as an Innovation Index standout in its 2025 Frost Radar™ for Managed Detection and Response and awarded the company its 2024 Competitive Strategy Leadership Award in the global MDR market.

Defend Like You Know What’s Coming™

Learn more at deepseas.com.

 

Position Summary

The Lead IR Analyst is a pivotal leader within DeepSeas’ cybersecurity operations. This role not only ensures the rapid detection, analysis, and resolution of security incidents, but also drives cross-functional coordination and continuous improvement. Responsibilities include triaging alerts, conducting forensic investigations, and implementing corrective actions to mitigate threats. The Lead IR Analyst elevates the function by leading strategic initiatives, mentoring junior team members, and shaping the development of incident response tools and playbooks, ensuring the organization remains resilient and proactive in the face of evolving cyber threats.

 

Key Responsibilities

The following are the major results needed for success in the role. Additional responsibilities, tasks, and duties will be assigned and required as needed.

  • Lead the IR Analyst team.
  • Serve as the point of contact and escalation point for all IR incidents.
  • Perform deep-dive and forensic analysis of logs, systems, and network traffic.
  • Document and lead incidents from detection through resolution.
  • Work with partners to ensure compliance and that proper processes are in place.
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and procedures.
  • Lead investigations of complex security incidents and coordinate response efforts.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior analysts.
  • Prepare detailed incident reports and executive summaries.
  • Provide accurate, punctual reports as required or assigned.

Experience, Education, and Skills Required

Below are the minimum skills, formalized training, practical experience, and/or education required to perform the general functions and duties of the role.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in incident response, security operations, or threat detection.
  • Experience with forensic analysis, malware investigation, and threat intelligence gathering.
  • Strong knowledge of SIEM tools, EDR, and forensic techniques.
  • Familiarity with malware analysis, log analysis, and network traffic inspection.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple incidents simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

Information Security Responsibility

Information security is everyone’s responsibility:

  • Understanding and following DeepSeas’ information security policies and procedures.
  • Remaining vigilant and reporting any suspicious activity or possible weaknesses in DeepSeas’ information security.

Why DeepSeas?

jobs.title: eLEND: Mortgage Servicing Analyst
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: http://www.elendtpo.com

🏡 About Us

At eLEND, we are committed to delivering an exceptional mortgage experience through innovation, technology, operational excellence, and client-focused partnership. Our Mortgage Servicing team plays a critical role in maintaining accurate loan records, supporting borrowers, managing servicing activities, and ensuring operational consistency throughout the servicing lifecycle.

The Mortgage Servicing Analyst is responsible for executing daily servicing activities, including loan boarding, servicing data maintenance, reconciliations, borrower inquiries, servicing transfers, operational reporting, and exception resolution.

This position works closely with Servicing leadership, Finance, Operations, internal departments, and third-party servicing partners to maintain accurate portfolio information, support regulatory compliance, and ensure servicing activities are completed efficiently and within established procedures.

✨ Why This Role Matters

As a Mortgage Servicing Analyst, you will help maintain the accuracy, integrity, and operational efficiency of eLEND's mortgage servicing portfolio.

While the AVP establishes priorities and monitors overall servicing performance, you will execute the core activities that keep our servicing operations running smoothly.

From boarding new loans and maintaining servicing platform data to researching borrower inquiries, reconciling accounts, and supporting servicing transfers, your work directly contributes to accurate records, timely borrower support, and operational consistency.

Success means maintaining reliable servicing data, resolving routine operational issues, meeting established deadlines, and supporting a compliant and efficient servicing environment.

🛠️ Key Responsibilities

🏡 New Loan Boarding & Data Validation

  • Execute new loan boarding activities within the servicing platform and interim servicing environment.

  • Validate loan boarding information against origination records to ensure accuracy and completeness.

  • Identify, research, and resolve loan boarding discrepancies and exceptions.

  • Maintain accurate loan-level information throughout the boarding process.

  • Coordinate with internal departments and servicing partners to address outstanding boarding requirements.

  • Escalate complex boarding issues or recurring discrepancies to senior servicing staff.

💻 Servicing Platform & Data Management

  • Maintain accurate servicing information within the Origination Platform, servicing systems, and interim servicing data feeds.

  • Review and update loan-level data to support accurate servicing records and portfolio reporting.

  • Monitor data consistency across origination and servicing environments.

  • Research discrepancies between servicing platforms and supporting documentation.

  • Complete assigned data maintenance activities within established procedures.

  • Support accurate portfolio analysis through timely and reliable servicing information.

📊 Accounting Reconciliations & Financial Accuracy

  • Research and clear routine corporate accounting reconciliation items related to mortgage servicing.

  • Review servicing invoices, escrow accounting records, and purchase advice discrepancies.

  • Identify and document reconciliation differences and supporting findings.

  • Coordinate with Finance and servicing partners to resolve routine discrepancies.

  • Escalate complex, unresolved, or aged reconciliation items to senior servicing staff.

  • Maintain organized documentation supporting reconciliation activities and resolutions.

🔄 Servicing Transfers & Portfolio Transitions

  • Support the preparation and execution of mortgage servicing transfers.

  • Prepare loan-level data files, borrower notices, transfer checklists, and supporting documentation.

  • Validate servicing transfer information for completeness and accuracy.

  • Complete assigned transfer responsibilities within established timelines.

  • Coordinate with internal departments and servicing partners to address transfer-related requirements.

  • Research and resolve routine servicing transfer exceptions.

  • Maintain accurate records supporting transfer activities and operational readiness.

📈 Servicing Reporting & Portfolio Analytics

  • Generate recurring mortgage servicing reports according to established schedules.

  • Validate servicing data used in operational reports and portfolio analysis.

  • Gather source information supporting the monthly Servicing Portfolio Report.

  • Support the preparation of servicing key performance indicators (KPIs) and subservicer scorecards.

  • Research reporting discrepancies and coordinate corrections when necessary.

  • Maintain accurate supporting documentation for recurring reporting activities.

  • Provide reliable servicing data to support leadership visibility into portfolio operations.

🔍 Subservicer Monitoring & Operational Oversight

  • Monitor daily subservicer and interim servicing activities for operational exceptions.

  • Review servicing activity for potential service-level concerns, discrepancies, and processing issues.

  • Investigate routine exceptions and document findings.

  • Track outstanding servicing issues and coordinate follow-up as appropriate.

  • Escalate recurring concerns, operational risks, or complex servicing matters requiring additional review.

  • Support consistent execution of servicing activities across internal and external servicing partners.

🏗️ Construction-to-Permanent Loan Monitoring

  • Monitor construction-to-permanent loan servicing activity.

  • Review loan-level information and complete required servicing updates.

  • Identify discrepancies, outstanding requirements, or items requiring corrective action.

  • Coordinate with appropriate departments or servicing partners to address routine issues.

  • Maintain accurate documentation of servicing updates and monitoring activities.

  • Escalate unresolved or complex matters to senior servicing staff.

💰 Interim Servicing & Transaction Processing

  • Process routine interim servicing transactions within documented procedures.

  • Research mortgage payment activity and related servicing discrepancies.

  • Support escrow administration and account maintenance activities.

  • Assist with payoff processing and related servicing updates.

  • Prepare and process borrower correspondence associated with servicing transactions.

  • Maintain accurate transaction records and supporting documentation.

  • Identify and escalate processing exceptions requiring additional review.

🤝 Borrower Inquiries & Customer Support

  • Research and respond to borrower inquiries involving mortgage payments, escrow accounts, payoff requests, servicing transfers, and other servicing activities.

  • Provide accurate, timely, and professional information to borrowers.

  • Coordinate with internal departments and servicing partners to research and resolve inquiries.

  • Identify and document borrower complaints according to established procedures.

  • Track outstanding borrower concerns and ensure appropriate follow-up.

  • Escalate complex inquiries, unresolved issues, or potential compliance concerns.

  • Support a consistent and positive borrower experience through clear communication and accurate servicing information.

🚨 Servicing Exception Management & Issue Resolution

  • Identify and investigate routine mortgage servicing exceptions.

  • Research discrepancies to determine root causes and appropriate corrective actions.

  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and servicing partners to resolve operational issues.

  • Maintain accurate records of exceptions, findings, corrective actions, and resolutions.

  • Monitor recurring exceptions and communicate trends to senior servicing staff.

  • Escalate complex issues, operational risks, or matters outside established procedures.

  • Support timely resolution while maintaining servicing accuracy and compliance.

⚖️ Audit, Investor & Regulatory Support

  • Gather and organize servicing documentation requested for audits, examinations, investor reviews, and regulatory inquiries.

  • Retrieve and validate loan-level servicing data and supporting records.

  • Review documentation for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Coordinate with internal departments to obtain requested servicing information.

  • Maintain organized records supporting audit and examination readiness.

  • Escalate discrepancies or potential compliance concerns identified during documentation reviews.

📚 Servicing Policies, Procedures & Documentation

  • Execute servicing responsibilities in accordance with documented procedures and internal controls.

  • Maintain accurate records of servicing activities, exceptions, and resolutions in designated systems.

  • Identify procedures that may no longer align with current operational practices.

  • Recommend updates that improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

  • Support the maintenance of organized and accessible servicing documentation.

  • Follow established escalation protocols when servicing activities require additional guidance.

  • Demonstrate accountability for completing assigned work accurately and on schedule.

⚙️ Process Improvement & Operational Efficiency

  • Identify opportunities to improve servicing workflows and reduce recurring operational errors.

  • Recommend improvements to data accuracy, reconciliation processes, reporting, and exception management.

  • Support servicing process improvement initiatives and operational readiness activities.

  • Contribute to servicing system conversions and other assigned projects.

  • Assist with evaluating recurring servicing issues and potential process enhancements.

  • Support consistent execution of servicing activities across platforms and servicing partners.

  • Promote efficiency while maintaining established controls and servicing standards.

🤝 Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Collaborate with Servicing leadership, Finance, Operations, and other internal departments.

  • Coordinate with subservicers and interim servicing partners to address operational needs.

  • Communicate servicing discrepancies, outstanding requirements, and resolution updates clearly.

  • Support Finance with reconciliation research and supporting documentation.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve borrower inquiries and servicing exceptions.

  • Contribute to servicing transfers, reporting activities, audits, and operational projects.

  • Maintain professional, responsive, and solutions-focused working relationships.

🔄 Cross-Training & Knowledge Sharing

  • Participate in cross-training activities to strengthen knowledge of mortgage servicing operations.

  • Share process knowledge, servicing findings, and operational best practices with team members.

  • Support operational continuity through accurate documentation and collaboration.

  • Remain informed about changes to servicing systems, workflows, and internal procedures.

  • Assist colleagues with servicing activities as business priorities require.

  • Perform additional duties aligned with business needs, competencies, and experience.

🌈 Team Culture & Accountability

  • Demonstrate ownership of assigned servicing responsibilities and operational deadlines.

  • Maintain high standards of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail.

  • Communicate servicing issues proactively and follow established escalation procedures.

  • Support collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

  • Remain adaptable as servicing priorities, portfolio needs, and business processes evolve.

  • Demonstrate eLEND's core values through daily actions and interactions.

🎯 What You Bring

🏠 Mortgage Servicing & Operations Experience

Must-Haves

  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in residential mortgage servicing or mortgage operations.

  • Working knowledge of mortgage servicing processes and basic servicing regulations.

  • Experience researching and resolving borrower inquiries, operational issues, or servicing exceptions.

  • Understanding of routine mortgage servicing activities and operational workflows.

  • Ability to execute assigned servicing responsibilities accurately and within established deadlines.

💻 Mortgage Systems & Data Management

  • Proficiency with mortgage-related software, including loan origination systems (LOS) or mortgage servicing platforms.

  • Ability to maintain accurate loan-level data across servicing systems.

  • Experience reviewing records, identifying discrepancies, and updating system information.

  • Comfort navigating servicing platforms and working with large volumes of mortgage data.

  • Strong attention to data integrity, accuracy, and documentation.

📊 Excel, Reconciliations & Financial Knowledge

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large data sets.

  • Basic understanding of accounting principles.

  • Ability to research data discrepancies and reconcile information across records.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to numerical accuracy.

  • Ability to organize and validate data supporting servicing operations.

🔍 Research & Problem Solving

  • Experience investigating borrower inquiries, servicing exceptions, or operational discrepancies.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to identify discrepancies, research potential causes, and coordinate routine resolutions.

  • Sound judgment in determining when additional guidance or escalation is necessary.

  • Resourceful and detail-oriented approach to operational challenges.

📆 Organization & Deadline Management

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to meet established deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple servicing responsibilities.

  • Ability to prioritize assigned work and maintain accurate records.

  • Comfort working independently within documented procedures and controls.

  • Consistent follow-through on outstanding servicing activities and operational issues.

🤝 Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to communicate servicing information clearly to borrowers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience coordinating with internal departments or external servicing partners.

  • Professional and solutions-focused approach to borrower inquiries and issue resolution.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively while maintaining accountability for assigned responsibilities.

🔄 Adaptability & Continuous Learning

  • Ability to adapt to changing servicing priorities, systems, and operational needs.

  • Willingness to learn new servicing processes and expand mortgage operations knowledge.

  • Comfortable participating in servicing initiatives, system conversions, and process improvement efforts.

  • Ability to identify opportunities to improve accuracy and operational efficiency.

  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

🌈 Values & Professional Standards

  • Ability to demonstrate eLEND's core values through daily actions and decisions.

  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and integrity.

  • Commitment to accuracy, compliance, borrower service, and teamwork.

  • Professional judgment when handling borrower information and servicing records.

  • Ability to contribute positively to a collaborative and service-focused environment.

⭐ Nice-to-Haves

  • Associate or bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

  • Experience with new loan boarding, servicing transfers, or interim servicing activities.

  • Experience supporting reconciliations, accounting activities, or operational reporting.

  • Prior mortgage call center or borrower-facing servicing experience.

🪑 Physical & Work Environment Requirements

  • Ability to perform desk-based responsibilities involving prolonged sitting and intermittent standing and walking.

  • Ability to perform routine computer and administrative tasks, including typing and handling servicing documentation.

  • Visual acuity sufficient for computer-based work and normal hearing for routine workplace communication.

  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 20 pounds.

  • Reasonable accommodations are available upon request with relevant documentation.

📆 A Day in the Life

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing newly originated loans scheduled for servicing boarding.

  • Validating loan boarding data against origination records and resolving discrepancies.

  • Updating servicing information within the Origination Platform and servicing systems.

  • Researching routine reconciliation items involving servicing invoices, escrow accounts, or purchase advice.

  • Preparing loan-level data files and documentation for upcoming servicing transfers.

  • Generating recurring servicing reports and validating portfolio information.

  • Gathering source data supporting monthly portfolio reporting, KPIs, and subservicer scorecards.

  • Monitoring daily subservicer activity and investigating operational exceptions.

  • Reviewing construction-to-permanent loan activity and completing required updates.

  • Processing interim servicing transactions involving payments, escrow administration, and payoff requests.

  • Responding to borrower inquiries and coordinating resolutions with servicing partners.

  • Identifying and documenting borrower complaints according to established procedures.

  • Researching servicing exceptions and escalating complex issues when necessary.

  • Gathering servicing documentation for audits, investor reviews, or regulatory examinations.

  • Collaborating with Finance, Operations, and Servicing leadership on outstanding items.

  • Updating servicing records, tracking tools, and supporting documentation.

  • Participating in servicing process improvement initiatives and operational projects.

  • Reinforcing a culture of accuracy, accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

Annual Base Salary: $91,400 - $114,250 based on experience 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k) plan with company participation

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

  • Access to tools, technology, and resources that support servicing accuracy and operational success

  • Collaborative and growth-oriented team environment

💼 Worksite

Worksite Arrangement: Remote

  • Mortgage servicing operations role supporting eLEND's servicing portfolio and interim servicing activities.

  • Responsible for daily loan boarding, servicing data maintenance, reconciliations, reporting, and borrower support.

  • Works closely with Servicing leadership, Finance, Operations, and third-party servicing partners.

  • Provides hands-on support for servicing transfers, operational exceptions, audits, and portfolio reporting.

  • Requires consistent attention to servicing accuracy, operational deadlines, borrower experience, and documented procedures.

⭐ How You'll Elevate the Experience

This role lives at the intersection of Own It and Relentless Pursuit of Better.

Own It starts with the details. A loan that boards accurately, a reconciliation that balances, and a servicing record that is correct the first time all contribute to a better borrower experience. You will take accountability for the accuracy of your work, follow through on servicing exceptions, and ensure assigned responsibilities are completed within established procedures and timelines. Ownership means recognizing that even routine servicing activities have a meaningful impact on borrowers, operational performance, and the integrity of our portfolio.

Relentless Pursuit of Better means looking beyond simply completing the task. You will recognize opportunities to improve servicing accuracy, identify recurring issues, and speak up when existing procedures no longer reflect how the work is performed. Rather than working around inefficiencies, you will help identify practical improvements that strengthen consistency, reduce errors, and support operational excellence.

Ultimately, you will help create a servicing operation that is accurate, accountable, efficient, compliant, and committed to delivering a consistent borrower experience while supporting the continued success of eLEND.

🌈 Equal Opportunity for All

At eLEND, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all team members are respected, supported, and empowered to succeed. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and business needs, ensuring equitable opportunities for all individuals regardless of background or identity.

💬 Stay Connected

Join today to connect with our team, stay informed about upcoming roles, and explore how your mortgage servicing experience, analytical skills, attention to detail, and commitment to operational excellence can help elevate the servicing experience at eLEND.
