About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Renewables Project Scheduler
jobs.description:
Apply

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for BESS projects from NTP through COD
  • Build schedules covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, civil, electrical, installation, commissioning, and grid interconnection
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

About us

Troostwijk & the TBAuctions group are part of one of Europe’s leading networks for digital B2B auctions. We market machines, vehicles, equipment and other commercial assets, bringing sellers and buyers together through digital processes and personal support.

What your day-to-day work will involve

As an Account Manager, you will develop the French seller market and act as the main point of contact for new and existing sellers. You will build a profitable portfolio, develop long-term relationships based on trust and guide opportunities from the first conversation through to active auction business.

The role combines remote work with regular travel and gives you direct influence on the development of our French market.

You will receive professional support from our teams and work with modern tools that help you structure your pipeline, follow-ups and seller relationships.

  • Identify, approach and acquire new sellers in the French market.

  • Present our activities and value proposition clearly to business owners and potential sellers.
  • Prepare meetings, understand seller needs and agree on clear next steps.
  • Own negotiations and follow opportunities through to conversion.
  • Keep pipeline, follow-ups and seller information structured with modern tools.
  • Represent our company image and values in the market and coordinate closely with internal teams.
What matters in this role

A perfect CV is less important than your ability to create relationships, develop a territory and turn commercial opportunities into long-term seller business.

Autonomy with professional support

You will own your territory and your seller relationships while working closely with internal teams that support you with expertise, coordination and operational follow-through. You will not be left alone with complex opportunities or process questions.

Build something with visible impact

Your benefits

Company car, computer, phone and meal tickets support you in your day-to-day work.

jobs.title: Closer (m/f) - Investor Relations in Düsseldorf
jobs.description:
Late shift. High stakes. Six US time zones. One shot per call.

This is a genuine job posting - not a ghost job!

Let's skip the part where we tell you this is “an exciting opportunity in a dynamic environment.” You've read that sentence four hundred times and seen it all.

Here's what's actually true:

We need an experienced, financially literate Closer who speaks English on a native or C2 Level, can pick up a phone at 3:30pm, talk to a stranger with eight figures in a brokerage account somewhere in Wyoming or Connecticut, get them to sign a convertible promissory note before their assistant walks in with coffee. That's it. That's the job. Everything else is detail.

Who We Are

Meridion AG runs the show from Monheim & Düsseldorf. Our US arm, Meridion Dynamics Inc., builds intelligent software and smart energy technology. But you're not selling the product. You're closing the investment that funds it. Different animal, different muscle.

Aufgaben

What You'll Actually Do

  • Take warm(ish) leads from our setters - accredited US investors who already know we called - and close them on convertible promissory notes.
  • Walk investors through the accreditation process without losing them to paperwork fatigue.
  • Hold the line, know the terms cold, and answer the “wait, what happens if you don't hit your IPO timeline” question without blinking.
  • If a setter is running low on appointments, out sick or on vacation, you step in and run up to 100 outbound cold calls that day to convert cold leads into your Closing appointments. Yes, a hundred. We count :)
  • Talk to people who have people and AI to screen their calls - and get past their Gatekeepers.

Qualifikation

What You Bring

  • Real closing experience - several years of it, in high-ticket sales, investment products, or anything else where “no” is the opening bid, not the final answer. This is not a rookie position.
  • English at a genuine native level. Not “I watched a lot of Suits.” You need to sound like you belong in a room with a family office CFO. If it's not your first language, we're talking true C2, no exceptions. An accent is no Dealbreaker but your vocabulary, your pronunciation, the way you use idioms - your vibe on the phone - must be on fleek.
  • A voice and presence that reads as calm, unbothered, and confident - think less “modern hustle culture” - more Brian Tracy.
  • Genuine understanding of what an accredited investor is, what a convertible note does, and why someone would put $50k+ into one. We'll brief you thoroughly - but you need financial literacy to keep up from day one.
  • A working understanding of US investor culture, even sitting in Düsseldorf’s Seestern District.

Benefits

The Deal

  • Full-time, 40h/week, onsite at our Düsseldorf office near Seestern.
  • Late shift: 2:30pm - 10pm, because your workday runs on Pacific and Eastern time, not Berlin time.
  • Base salary + commission
  • Onboarding is real: Expect a genuine ramp-up before you're fully solo on calls.
  • Start: ASAP - which translates to “realistically September/October”.

Not For You If

You cling to a script forever to feel confident. You've never been told “no” 70 times in a day and called it Tuesday. You think “Closer” means you show up after someone else already did the hard part.

Sound like your Tuesday? Send us your CV.
We don’t do 5 interview rounds.
You talk to me on the phone or in a brief Teams Video Call.

If I sense you’re a fit, we’ll welcome you onsite for another brief interview with our CEO; please plan in approximately 2h for the interview, a brief vibe check with the team and one or two test calls so we can hear your closing performance.

That’s it.

jobs.title: Junior Consultant in der Medizin (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die meisten Einstiegsjobs in der Unternehmensberatung bedeuten:
Analysen vorbereiten. Präsentationen bauen. Dem Senior Consultant zuarbeiten.

Dieser nicht.

Bei uns hast Du bereits früh direkten Kontakt mit Praxisinhabern, die sich für eine Zusammenarbeit mit uns interessieren. Du besprichst mit Ihnen „wo der Schuh drückt“ und zeigst Lösungsansätze auf. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Beratern entstehen konkrete Lösungskonzepte, deren Umsetzung Du als Assistenz mitbegleitest.

Denn Mediziner sind hervorragend ausgebildet, um Patienten zu behandeln. Darauf, ein Unternehmen mit Mitarbeitern, Prozessen, Kennzahlen und wirtschaftlicher Verantwortung zu führen, bereitet sie ihr Studium dagegen kaum vor.

Genau hier kommen wir ins Spiel.

Wer wir sind

Die MediKom Consulting GmbH ist eine auf ambulante Medizin spezialisierte Unternehmensberatung mit Sitz in Nürnberg. Wir haben hunderte Arztpraxen dabei begleitet, ihre Wirtschaftlichkeit zu verbessern und ihre Zukunft zu sichern. Wir sind zwölf feste und freie Mitarbeitende. Das heißt: Deine Arbeit ist sichtbar. Niemand muss sie erst durch drei Hierarchieebenen tragen.

Aufgaben

Was du tust

Als Junior Consultant arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Beratungsprojekten für niedergelassene Ärzte und medizinische Einrichtungen.

  • Analyse.
    Du analysierst Arztpraxen nach unserem Beratungssystem und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale bei Prozessen, Organisation, Mitarbeiterführung, Kommunikation, Marketing und Wirtschaftlichkeit.
  • Kennzahlenmanagement.
    Du erfasst und analysierst monatlich die betriebswirtschaftlichen Kennzahlen unserer Mandanten, bereitest sie verständlich auf und schaffst damit eine fundierte Grundlage für unternehmerische Entscheidungen.
  • Konzeption und Umsetzung.
    Aus deinen Analysen entwickelst du konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen und begleitest unsere Mandanten bei der Umsetzung – praxisnah, lösungsorientiert und mit Blick auf messbare Ergebnisse.
  • Strategietage und Workshops.
    Du unterstützt unsere Consultants bei Strategietagen und Beratungsterminen, häufig direkt vor Ort in den Arztpraxen.
  • Schnittstelle zum Marketing.
    Du erkennst den Unterstützungsbedarf unserer Mandanten bei Themen wie Praxismarketing, Patientenkommunikation oder Recruiting und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit unserem Marketing-Team.
  • Schnittstelle zu Steuerberatern.
    Du stehst im Austausch mit den Steuerberatern unserer Mandanten, holst relevante Unterlagen ein und bereitest betriebswirtschaftliche Daten für unsere Analysen auf.
  • Projektmanagement.
    Du koordinierst Aufgaben und Termine, behältst den Projektfortschritt im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte Maßnahmen umgesetzt werden.

Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung und führst schließlich eigene Beratungsprojekte.

Qualifikation

Wen wir suchen

Wir suchen keinen fertigen Unternehmensberater.

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die einer werden will.

Du möchtest verstehen, warum manche Unternehmen hervorragend funktionieren und andere trotz guter Voraussetzungen weit hinter ihren Möglichkeiten bleiben. Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen, erkennst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, mit Menschen zu arbeiten und Veränderungen voranzutreiben.

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

  • ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in BWL, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Gesundheitsmanagement, Controlling oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich,
  • ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und Freude am Umgang mit Zahlen,
  • ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten,
  • eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und strukturiertes Denken,
  • eine selbstständige und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise,
  • ein souveränes und kommunikatives Auftreten,
  • Organisationstalent und hohe Zuverlässigkeit,
  • Entscheidungsfreude und Eigeninitiative,
  • die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen,
  • Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Mandanten,
  • den Anspruch, dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Entscheidend ist für uns, was du lernen und bewegen möchtest.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Leistungsbezogene Bezahlung ohne Deckelung
  • Ein Mentor statt Onboarding-PDF. Du arbeitest direkt mit Wolfgang Apel zusammen, der dieses Unternehmen aufgebaut und Host des Podcast „Unternehmen Arztpraxis“ ist. Was du hier in zwei Jahren lernst, lernst du in einem Konzern in fünf nicht.
  • Sicherer Job in einem krisenfesten Markt. Der Bedarf an ambulanter Versorgung wächst, unabhängig von der Konjunktur.
  • 30 Urlaubstage. Die gesetzlichen 20, plus 10 von uns obendrauf.
  • Bezahlte Fort- und Weiterbildung.
  • Präsenz statt Homeoffice. Ein Team, das sich im selben Raum sieht.
  • Moderne, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze. Gute Anbindung mit Auto und ÖPNV. Regelmäßige Team-Events. Und einen Dachgarten, auf dem im Sommer die besten Gespräche stattfinden.

So läuft die Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, deine Zeugnisse und drei Sätze dazu, warum du glaubst, dass Unternehmensberatung im medizinischen Umfeld genau das Richtige für dich ist.

Rückmeldung binnen 72 Stunden, wenn deine Bewerbung unserem Profil entspricht.

jobs.title: Pflichtpraktikum im Bereich Tech (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind PsyCurio, ein HealthTech-Startup, das Psychotherapie mit Virtual Reality neu denkt. Wir bauen eine VR-gestützte Therapie-Infrastruktur, die Therapeut:innen im klinischen Alltag entlastet und Patient:innen Zugang zu strukturierten, wirksamen und modernen Übungen ermöglicht, etwa bei Angststörungen, Suchterkrankungen oder anderen psychischen Belastungen.

Unser Ziel ist klar: Psychotherapeutische Versorgung soll zugänglicher, messbarer und skalierbarer werden. Für Patient:innen, für Therapeut:innen und für ein Gesundheitssystem, das neue Lösungen braucht, statt nur längere Wartelisten zu verwalten.

Du arbeitest bei uns an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Psychologie, MedTech und Virtual Reality. Dabei unterstützt du uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer VR-Anwendungen, beim Testen und Optimieren unserer Software und Hardware, bei KI-Experimenten und der Evaluation neuer VR-Technologien sowie bei der Frage, wie digitale Therapie technisch zuverlässig und sinnvoll in den klinischen Alltag integriert werden kann. Du bist nicht nur dabei, sondern arbeitest aktiv an Themen mit, die für Therapeut:innen und Patient:innen einen echten Unterschied machen können.

Tasks

Je nach aktuellen Projekten unterstützt du uns unter anderem bei:

  • der Weiterentwicklung und Anpassung unserer VR-Szenarien in Unity: Du setzt kleinere Features um und behebst Bugs

  • Software Testing & QA: Du testest Szenarien, dokumentierst Bugs und führst Regressionstests durch

  • der Einrichtung und Pflege unserer VR-Hardware: Du setzt Headsets auf, installierst und aktualisierst Software und prüfst, ob alles zuverlässig läuft

  • technischer Dokumentation: Du pflegst Anleitungen, Testprotokolle und Entwicklerdokumentation, damit Wissen im Team nicht verloren geht

  • der Integration und Optimierung von 3D-Assets sowie einfachen Animationen

  • KI-Experimenten: Du evaluierst KI-Tools für 360°-Umgebungen und VR-Inhalte und baust erste Prototypen

  • Performance-Analysen: Du untersuchst Framerate, Ladezeiten und Standalone-Performance

  • Automatisierung: Du schreibst kleine Skripte für Tests und wiederkehrende Prozesse

  • technischem Support: Du reproduzierst Probleme und analysierst technische Fehler

  • Recherchen zu neuen VR-Technologien, Unity-Tools und Integrationen

  • Themen, die im Hintergrund wichtig sind und für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologie einen echten Unterschied machen

Requirements

  • Du studierst Informatik, Medieninformatik, Game Development, Software Engineering oder ein vergleichbares Fach

  • Du suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum, bei dem du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern wirklich mitarbeitest

  • Du bringst Programmiergrundlagen in mindestens einer Sprache mit, idealerweise C#

  • Softwareentwicklung, Virtual Reality, DeepTech/ DeepMind und XR findest du spannend

  • Du denkst mit, stellst gute Fragen und möchtest Dinge verstehen und verbessern

  • Struktur, Eigeninitiative und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich und du gehst Probleme lösungsorientiert an

  • Du würdest gern in einem kleinen, interdisziplinären Team aus Tech, Psychologie und Forschung arbeiten

  • Deutsch und Englisch sind für dich kein Problem, auch für technische Dokumentation

  • Du hast schon erste Erfahrungen mit VR Entwicklung gesammelt

  • Erfahrung mit Unity und C#, Meta Quest/OpenXR, Blender oder anderen 3D-Tools, Git, Python, Debugging und Softwaretests oder generativer KI/LLMs ist wünschenswert. Auch Interesse an Digital Health und Psychologie freut uns

  • Dein Lebenslauf muss nicht perfekt sein. Viel wichtiger sind Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echtes Interesse

Benefits

Bei PsyCurio tauchst du tief in die Welt eines HealthTech-Startups ein, das Psychologie, Virtual Reality, Forschung und MedTech zusammenbringt. Du arbeitest an Themen mit direkter Relevanz für die psychotherapeutische Versorgung und bekommst Einblick in Produktentwicklung, wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen und kliniknahe Anwendungen.

Das Praktikum ist unvergütet. Dafür erlebst du das rasante Tempo eines Startups, übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung und bringst deine eigenen Ideen ein. Die Wege sind kurz, der Austausch ist direkt und du sitzt nicht nur in Meetings, sondern bewegst wirklich etwas.

Du arbeitest bei uns vollständig remote und kannst das Praktikum in Vollzeit für bis zu drei Monate oder entsprechend länger in Teilzeit absolvieren. Abschluss- oder Projektarbeiten sind nach Absprache ebenfalls möglich. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, sprechen wir gern über eine weitere Zusammenarbeit, zum Beispiel als Werkstudent:in.

Klingt spannend? Dann erzähl uns, warum du Lust hast, bei PsyCurio dabei zu sein, was dich an Virtual Reality, MedTech oder digitaler Gesundheit fasziniert und wie du unser Team unterstützen kannst. Schick uns gern Links zu deinem Portfolio, deinem GitHub-Profil oder einem VR-Projekt, auf das du stolz bist.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Engineer
jobs.description:
At Uni Systems, we are working towards turning digital visions into reality. We are continuously growing and we are looking for a professional ServiceNow Engineer to join our UniQue Brussels team.

What will you be bringing to the team?

  • Design, develop, customize, configure, administer, and maintain ServiceNow solutions, ensuring alignment with business and operational requirements.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize ServiceNow integrations with internal and external systems using REST, SOAP, JDBC, and other integration protocols.
  • Develop and maintain custom ServiceNow scripts and applications using JavaScript and platform APIs, including GlideRecord, GlideAjax, Script Includes, and related scripting capabilities.
  • Configure, customize, and integrate ServiceNow modules, including IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), and Configuration Management Database (CMDB).
  • Design, implement, and maintain ServiceNow workflows, Flow Designer subflows, UI Policies, reusable components, and automated processes.
  • Configure and manage data imports, exports, transformations, and integrations, ensuring data accuracy, integrity, security, and compliance.
  • Implement and maintain authentication and authorization mechanisms for ServiceNow integrations, including OAuth and Basic Authentication.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and external enterprise platforms, operational tools, and third-party systems.
  • Conduct functional, integration, and regression testing using the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).
  • Monitor and maintain ServiceNow platform health, performance, usage, and compliance, identifying and resolving technical issues.
  • Support ServiceNow platform upgrades, enhancements, customizations, and continuous development.
  • Administer and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure, including physical and virtual servers, storage systems, and integrated technology platforms.
  • Configure, administer, and troubleshoot VMware environments, including vSphere, vSAN, and Horizon.
  • Administer Windows, Linux, and UNIX operating systems in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Design, implement, and administer backup and recovery solutions, including Veeam and HPE StoreOnce.
  • Administer enterprise storage technologies, including traditional SAN, NAS, Ceph, vSAN, and distributed file systems.
  • Administer server infrastructure, including blade systems, composable infrastructure, and Oracle platforms such as Exadata and Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA).
  • Administer OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) and supporting technologies, including Red Hat Service Mesh, GitHub, Helm, GitOps, Ansible Automation Platform, and Kafka.
  • Develop, execute, maintain, and troubleshoot automation scripts using Ansible and PowerShell.
  • Administer Active Directory, LDAP, Keycloak, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and digital certificate lifecycle processes.
  • Administer and maintain monitoring and observability platforms, including Nagios, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Fluentd, Kibana, and Jaeger.
  • Administer mail servers and mail relays, including Postfix, antivirus, and anti-spam solutions.
  • Support database environments, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and Elasticsearch.
  • Manage centralized software deployment, patching, updates, hardware and software inventories, and configuration management.
  • Ensure the effective development, administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform and its associated services.
  • Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions in collaboration with stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Ensure the reliability, performance, security, and interoperability of ServiceNow integrations with internal and external systems.
  • Maintain the accuracy, integrity, security, and compliance of data exchanged between ServiceNow and connected systems.
  • Monitor ServiceNow platform health, performance, usage, and compliance, proactively identifying risks and implementing corrective measures.
  • Ensure the quality, reliability, and scalability of ServiceNow configurations, customizations, integrations, and workflows through appropriate testing procedures.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize ServiceNow processes, automate workflows, improve platform functionality, and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshoot complex ServiceNow development, integration, configuration, and platform-related issues.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, security, performance, and operational continuity of enterprise IT infrastructure and business-critical systems.
  • Provide advanced technical support and troubleshoot complex hardware, software, operating system, virtualization, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Monitor infrastructure capacity, performance, and availability, identifying potential problems and implementing corrective measures.
  • Ensure compliance with established IT security policies, technical standards, configuration requirements, and software licensing obligations.
  • Support highly available and geographically distributed IT environments, ensuring operational resilience and service continuity across multiple sites.
  • Participate in incident, problem, change, capacity, and configuration management processes in accordance with ITIL practices.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, operational procedures, and infrastructure records.
  • Coordinate with internal technical teams, stakeholders, and external service providers to ensure effective service delivery and resolution of technical issues.
  • Identify and propose opportunities for infrastructure modernization, automation, standardization, and technology improvements.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of IT services and ensure that technology solutions meet the operational requirements of the European Institution.

Requirements

What do you need to succeed in this position?

  • Master Degree + minimum nine years of relevant professional experience in IT systems engineering, enterprise platforms, ServiceNow development, administration, implementation, or related technical domains.
  • Strong proficiency in ServiceNow platform development, administration, configuration, and customization.
  • Advanced JavaScript programming skills and practical experience with ServiceNow APIs, including GlideRecord, GlideAjax, and Script Includes.
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining REST and SOAP integrations, including authentication mechanisms such as OAuth and Basic Authentication.
  • Experience with data imports, exports, transformation processes, and integration troubleshooting.
  • Practical knowledge of ServiceNow modules, including ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, and CMDB.
  • Experience with Flow Designer, subflows, UI Policies, workflow automation, and reusable components.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and functional and integration testing.
  • Advanced knowledge of VMware technologies, particularly vSphere, vSAN, and Horizon.
  • Experience administering Red Hat Linux and Windows Server environments at enterprise scale.
  • Knowledge of server hardware management, including blade systems, composable infrastructure, racking, cabling, hardware replacement, firmware upgrades, and inventory management.
  • Experience with Oracle infrastructure, particularly Exadata and ZDLRA.
  • Advanced knowledge of SAN, NAS, Ceph, vSAN, and distributed file systems.
  • Experience administering backup and recovery solutions, particularly Veeam and HPE StoreOnce.
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, LDAP, Keycloak, PKI, digital certificates, and centralized IT security policies.
  • Experience with software deployment, patch management, configuration management, and software compliance.
  • Advanced knowledge of OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) administration and supporting technologies, including Red Hat Service Mesh, GitHub, Helm, GitOps, Ansible Automation Platform, and Kafka.
  • Advanced scripting and automation skills using Ansible and PowerShell.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms, including Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Fluentd, Kibana, Jaeger, Nagios, and Splunk.
  • Knowledge of mail servers and mail relays, particularly Postfix, antivirus, and anti-spam solutions.
  • Basic knowledge of database technologies, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and Elasticsearch.
  • Familiarity with ITIL/ITIL V3 processes, particularly incident, problem, change, capacity, and configuration management.
  • Experience with on-premises implementations and integrations would be considered an advantage.
  • ServiceNow Administrator, Implementer, or Developer certifications would be considered an advantage.
  • Good knowledge of English

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

  • Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

  • Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

  • Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

  • Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

Job Description

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the internal platform that powers Enpal's applications and services. You will set technical direction, raise the bar on engineering standards, and drive cross-team initiatives that make our platform more reliable, secure, and scalable. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership, senior platform engineers, and development teams, acting as a force multiplier through mentorship, architectural guidance, and hands-on contribution to the platform's hardest problems.

 

This role is ideal for engineers who have deep, proven expertise in platform and cloud engineering and want to shape the technical strategy of a growing engineering organization, not just execute within it.

At Enpal, you would be:

  • Owning platform architecture. Define and evolve the architecture of our internal platform, making build-vs-buy and long-term design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Driving infrastructure automation at scale. Lead the design of automation and self-service tooling that removes manual toil across deployment, provisioning, and operations for the whole engineering org, not just your own team.

  • Setting technical standards. Establish best practices for Kubernetes operations, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure as code, and ensure they are adopted consistently across teams.

  • Elevating the developer experience. Treat the platform as a product for internal teams: drive usability, reliability, and documentation improvements that let engineers ship faster and safer, and define the metrics that prove it.

  • Mentoring and growing engineers. Coach platform and junior engineers, review designs and code, and raise the overall technical level of the team through pairing, documentation, and feedback.

  • Leading complex, cross-team initiatives. Take ownership of high-impact projects that span multiple teams, from scoping and design through rollout, with minimal oversight.

  • Driving continuous improvement. Proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and technical debt, and lead the changes that materially improve stability, performance, and automation.

  • Partnering across the organization. Work closely with developers, operations, security, and leadership to understand real needs and translate them into platform solutions and roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and a track record of leading platform initiatives.

  • 8+ years of experience in platform, cloud, DevOps, or software engineering roles, including significant time operating production systems at scale.

  • Proven, hands-on expertise with cloud environments and containerized applications (Azure, Kubernetes and more), including designing and operating production-grade clusters.

  • Deep experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD tooling, Helm and observability tooling, with the judgment to choose the right approach for a given problem.

  • A demonstrated track record of leading technical initiatives end to end, from design through rollout, across multiple teams.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team, including through code/design review and documentation.

  • Strong system design skills, with the ability to reason about trade-offs in reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Clear communication skills in English, spoken and written, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels. Knowledge of German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience setting up or scaling platform teams in a fast-growing organization.

  • Deep understanding of monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices, including on-call ownership and postmortems.

  • Contributions to open-source platform or infrastructure tooling.

  • Experience operating in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (e.g., energy, fintech).

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: SEO Content Manager
jobs.description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next SEO Content Manager, you'll help us build the UK's go-to home improvement marketplace by owning how we show up in search. Organic search is one of our most important growth channels, and this role sits at the heart of it. Reporting into the Head of SEO, you'll shape our SEO content strategy as well as deliver it, and you'll help define how Checkatrade shows up in AI-driven search, LLMs and an increasingly agentic web, where AI agents find, compare and book tradespeople on people's behalf. If you're energised by a fast-moving landscape and finding the signal in the noise, this is your chance to help shape what comes next.

The job, unfiltered:

  • Own the content strategy and roadmap end to end across evergreen, seasonal and intent-led content, prioritising by business impact rather than volume, and shape the approach for Rated People as we rebuild the brand so it grows alongside Checkatrade without competing for the same demand.

  • Dig into hundreds of URLs and thousands of keywords using GSC, Ahrefs and crawlers to spot the biggest opportunities and risks, fix issues like thin, cannibalising or orphaned content, and turn what you find into clear, prioritised recommendations for senior stakeholders rather than status updates.

  • Shape how our content is structured and written for AI-driven search and agentic discovery, from Google AI Overviews to ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI agents, while building agentic workflows for briefs, analysis and reporting and setting the standard for how the team uses AI.

  • Run our freelance writing operation: set standards, hire and develop writers, and manage quality, output and cost using data on writer performance and content ROI.

  • Own content experimentation and EEAT, from how hypotheses are formed, tested and read, through to authorship, on-page trust signals and how expert input is presented.

  • Set the SEO agenda in digital PR alongside PR and Corporate Affairs, and build our Search Everywhere strategy across TikTok, YouTube, Instagram and Reddit, with Reddit a priority for consumer credibility and LLM citations.

The fit:

  • Strong content-led SEO experience at scale, with a clear grasp of search intent, content architecture, EEAT and what makes content rank and convert, and writing skills grounded in Google's Search Quality Rater Guidelines and modern search best practice.

  • Confidence working directly in the data: pulling and interpreting GSC, Ahrefs and crawler data (such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb) yourself rather than relying on pre-built dashboards.

  • A track record of owning projects from problem to measurable outcome without close oversight.

  • Experience managing freelancers or agencies, with a structured approach to briefing, reviewing and developing writers.

  • Off-site SEO and digital PR experience, including campaigns that built topical authority and working with PR teams to brief in SEO requirements and measure impact.

  • A working understanding of GEO/AEO and how content surfaces in generative search, hands-on experience with (or a strong appetite for) AI and agentic workflows, and clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholders.

(Don't self-select out because you don't tick every box. We'd rather meet you.)

What you get

💰 Competitive salary, annual bonus & equity scheme

🩺 Health, wellbeing and learning support

🚲 Access to Wellhub, Smart Tech Scheme, Cycle Scheme & season ticket loans

🎂 Birthday/special day leave, buy & sell holiday scheme

❤️ 1 week's paid charity leave, and more

How this goes

  • 1st stage: interview with our Head of SEO

  • 2nd stage: meet with our Commercial Director

  • Final stage: A short case study that you will present to our panel in our London office

Not this one? Stay close anyway. Join the Talent Community and we'll ping you the second something better fits.

About us

We’re Checkatrade – the UK’s leading platform for finding a tradesperson. With more than 50,000 trades listed and over 6 million reviews, we help homeowners get jobs done right and help tradespeople grow their business.

We’re growing fast, with big plans to become the go-to brand for home improvements. If you care about great work, take pride in the details, and want to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (Hands-on) - Offer
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. jobs.title: Business Lead - Pitstops
jobs.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

The opportunity

Pitstops are the local shops that power Relay. Every day, thousands of corner shops, newsagents and convenience stores take in parcels from our vans, hand them to couriers on bikes and in cars, and serve customers dropping off and picking up. They’re the reason we can deliver faster and cheaper than the big carriers. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Next is the rest of the UK and the US.

This role owns making that network work. That means the right pitstops, at a pay that works for them and for us. When one goes wrong, you see it the same day in parcels left behind and routes running late. You’ll build the systems that stop that happening, and fix it fast when it does.

About the role

  • Pitstop capacity vs required. Enough active, open pitstops with headroom in each zone. Working with the sales team to close capacity gaps as we grow and expand and the data team to model how our capacity will grow and change as we make it easier to work with us.

  • Undelivered and uncollected parcels on PUDO routes. The daily rate, and how fast it’s recovered. You own the strategy for the automated processes and app flows that drive it down.

  • Pitstop pricing economics. Pay per bag and scan, and the target rate by area, understanding how this impacts our contribution margin as a business.

  • Activation throughput. Getting signed pitstops live and up to speed as fast as possible. We’ve grown from a few hundred pitstops to thousands in two years. Now we need to do that across the UK and in the US.

What you’ll do

  1. Lead pitstop strategy and metrics. Turn the outcomes above into the parts you can control, a roadmap and named owners. Work with Engineering and Data to deliver it. Hold a weekly results review: what we expected, what happened, what we do next.

  2. Own delivery-today and recovery for pitstops. Rejections, closures, caps and redirects. Make sure each failure type has a playbook and an owner, and track how often recovery works. Replace scrappy manual processes with automated systems, fast.

  3. Own pricing. Find opportunities for pricing experiments, such as variable rates. Set guardrails and rollback triggers. Recommend rates by area, ensuring we stay in line with competitors. Work with Commercial, who own the rate quoted at signing.

  4. Make Relay easy to run alongside a shop. Pitstops are small businesses working with us on the side of their main trade. Every scan, bag and app screen costs them time. Understand what it’s like to be a pitstop. Remove friction from their day, and make sure the volume and pay they get from us stay worth it.

What you’ll need

  • Ownership. You run outcomes, not tasks. A good week is one where the metrics you own move the right way, quickly.

  • Comfort with data. You can read a dashboard, question a number and frame an experiment. SQL is a plus, not a must.

  • Ops judgement. You know when to fix today’s problem and when to fix the system behind it.

  • A bias to automate. You’d rather build the system once than do the same task twice. You ship a rough first version fast, then improve it. Whatever you design has to work at ten times today’s size.

  • Influence. You get work done through teams you don’t manage, and you write things down so knowledge is shared.

  • Experience. Operations, marketplace or commercial roles in logistics, delivery or similar networks.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

  • Starkes Gespür für Ideen und Skripte: Du schreibst YouTube-Skripte selbst, die Zuschauer bis zum Ende halten

  • Editing auf hohem Niveau: Longform, Shortform und cinematic – idealerweise bist du selbst Creator

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kamera, Licht und Ton: Du kannst selbst drehen

  • Verständnis für Video-Ads und ihre Rolle im Funnel und in der Customer Journey

  • Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten Kennzahlen wie CTR, Zuschauerbindung, Views und CPL

  • Führungserfahrung: Du steuerst mehrere Cutter gleichzeitig, planst Produktion und gibst Feedback, das dein Team besser macht

  • Hohe Standards: Kein Video verlässt dein Team, hinter dem du nicht selbst stehst

Du passt eher nicht zu uns, wenn …

  • du einfach nur einen Job suchst und nicht bereit bist, dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
The Software Developer I, Connector role supports Trial Interactive’s proprietary platform, Connector - the cloud-based integrations that move life science data between clients’ clinical systems (for example EDC/eCRF and IRT systems) and Trial Interactive’s life science products. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the role helps build and maintain connectors, keeps client data flowing accurately, and resolves issues when it does not.

This is a blended role, covering development and maintenance up until handling client requests. This role works closely with the Solutions, DevOps and Engineering teams.

DESCRIPTION

As part of the Development and maintenance responsibility, the resource handles:

• Develop, test and maintain connector components in C# on .NET (AWS Lambda), including the parsers and mappers that convert source-system data (API payloads, files) into the formats required by the Trial Interactive CTMS and eTMF.

• Configure and extend mappings for new studies, sites and visit/status definitions on existing connectors, reusing existing modules wherever possible.

• Assist in the technical onboarding of new clients and studies: connector configuration, test runs in non-production environments, and verification before go-live.

• Work with the AWS services connectors are built on (Lambda, SQS, S3, EventBridge/Step Functions, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and make small, reviewed infrastructure changes using Terraform under supervision.

• Consume, test and troubleshoot REST APIs (client/vendor APIs and Trial Interactive import APIs) using code and tools such as Postman, and help extend APIs that improve connector stability and connectivity.

• Write unit and functional tests; use Git (feature branches, merge requests, environment branches) and follow the team’s code review and release process.

• Keep code, configuration and change records documented so that others can maintain them.

• Work on special projects, such as local test environments using LocalStack.

As part of handling Client communication, support and ticket resolution, the resource does:

• Own assigned support tickets from triage to closure: reproduce the issue, investigate, fix or escalate, and record the outcome in the ticketing system (for example Jira, ServiceDesk Plus).

• Investigate data issues end to end – trace a record from the source payload through the archive, parser, connector database and logs to its CTMS/eTMF import result – and establish the root cause (RCA) with evidence.

• Reconcile source-system data against the CTMS/eTMF when a client reports missing or mismatched subjects, visits or statuses, and explain any differences.

• Communicate with clients and Solutions Engineers by email, tickets and calls: acknowledge requests promptly, ask clear clarifying questions, give regular status updates, and explain findings and next steps in plain language.

• Monitor connector health (CloudWatch logs, failed imports, notifications) and respond to failures within agreed response times.

• Escalate appropriately to senior engineers, DevOps or the vendor, with a concise summary of what happened, when, in which environment and for which records.

• Write up RCAs, fixes and known issues so that repeat problems are resolved faster, and help keep support documentation current.

• Handle client and clinical data with care: use the minimum data needed, never share one client’s information with another, and follow Trial Interactive data-protection and change-control procedures.

General

• Keep learning the connector platform, the clinical-trial data domain and cloud and software development best practices.

• Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the manager/supervisor.


REQUIRED SKILLS

• Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues in plain language to non-technical clients and to write concise ticket updates and emails.

• A client-service mindset: responsive, calm under pressure, and takes ownership of a ticket until it is resolved or properly handed over.

• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills: forms a hypothesis, checks logs and data, and proves the root cause with evidence before concluding.

• Strong attention to detail with data, such as identifiers, dates, time zones and character encodings.

• Good time management: balances planned development work with interrupt-driven support, prioritizing by client impact.

• Works collaboratively within a team, asks for help early, and is self-motivated and eager to learn.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 0–1 years of experience in software development, technical support or cloud-based application support; internships and substantial academic or personal projects count.

• Working knowledge of C# and the .NET framework: able to read and debug existing code and deliver small features.

• Familiarity with AWS, particularly Lambda, S3, SQS and CloudWatch Logs.

• Working SQL skills (joins, filtering, aggregation) on relational databases, preferably MySQL.

• Understanding of REST APIs and of JSON, XML and CSV data; experience calling APIs with Postman or similar tools.

• Understanding of data parsing and mapping techniques, including handling of dates, null values and encodings.

• Experience or familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Experience with LocalStack for local AWS cloud application development.

• Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• Prior experience in customer-facing support, or with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceDesk Plus.

• Exposure to clinical research systems and concepts (EDC, CTMS, eTMF; study, site, subject, visit) or to regulated (GxP) software environments.

• Scripting (Python or shell) for data checks and log analysis.

• Familiarity with containerization and microservices architecture.

🎯 Le Rôle

jobs.title: Android Developer
jobs.description:
At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with your future colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare.

We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer at Luscii, you will build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role

As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.

  • Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early.

  • Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable.

  • Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues.

  • Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least five years of experience in Android or mobile development and extensive experience with Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow.

  • You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment.

  • You have experience with clean architecture, software design patterns and approaches such as MVVM or MVI, and you understand how to apply them in maintainable mobile applications.

  • You have experience with Jetpack Compose, mobile unit and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and Android design guidelines.

  • You understand mobile performance and reliability, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation, as well as working with web services, cloud platforms and APIs.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.
