jobs.title: Platform Associate
jobs.description:
Platform Associate (m/f/d): Talent, Growth, Content & AI Workflows

Remote, with offices in Munich and Karlsruhe · Start January or February 2027

About us

First Momentum invests in deep tech and industrial tech founders across Europe at pre-seed when there's more lab than traction. We've made 40+ investments into industries like energy, space, industrial, and semicon, and our companies went on to raise from Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, or Insight Partners.

We're a team of engineers, scientists, and operators on a mission to build a different kind of VC fund. Our goal isn't the biggest fund or the loudest headlines, but to be the VC deeply technical teams need and deserve at inception. Someone who truly understands their tech, is humble and candid, and connects them with the relevant people they need at a given stage, be it a designer or a pilot customer. You won't find us at the after-party; instead, we're obsessing over good reads, fast bikes, and the latest moonshots we want to bring to life.

Your tasks

For us, platform is like a product with multiple customer groups: founders, LPs, Scouts, and the investment team. While we get inspired by playbooks and what other funds are doing, we treat them as what they are: past successes. For us, platform is much more similar to what our portfolio teams are doing: building products and driving growth, whether for our fund or our portcos. We come up with new ideas, identify the most impactful ones, test them, measure, iterate, or drop them and rerun the entire sprint. Your north star: helping our portfolio founders succeed through intros, hires, and any other random request. We measure ourselves on support per euro invested. Much of that support runs through the Platform team.

Call it Founder's Associate, Chief of Staff, Venture Ops, GTM, or Growth. Here, it means you take on some of the most pressing problems of our portfolio companies and the fund operations. You'll work with several super-technical, highly humble founders and the investment team at once.

jobs.title: Growth Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Rund 74 % aller CO₂-Emissionen in Deutschland entstehen im Zusammenhang mit der Energieproduktion, das sind über 543 Millionen Tonnen pro Jahr.

Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an.

Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren.

Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig.

Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen.

Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du übernimmst unser Marketing von den Gründern und baust es weiter aus. Einiges läuft bereits, vieles existiert noch nicht. Dein Job ist es, daraus eine Growth-Maschine zu machen: Du verantwortest Lead-Volumen, Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten, testest den Funnel konsequent durch und entscheidest, welche Kanäle wie viel Budget bekommen. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet und auch keinen reinen Creative, sondern jemanden mit Performance-Mindset, der Kanäle versteht, Tests selbst aufsetzt und das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100 % eigenverantwortlich ownt.

  • Growth-Strategie und Budget: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern den Marketing-Plan, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und steuerst Soll gegen Ist.

  • Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen liegen komplett bei dir. Du skalierst, was funktioniert, testest laufend neue Kampagnen und Zielgruppen und optimierst auf Lead-Qualität, nicht nur auf Volumen. Neue Kanäle testest du an, wenn die Zahlen es hergeben.

  • Funnel und Conversion: Du baust und testest Landingpages und Funnels, optimierst Qualifizierung, Formulare und On-Page Conversion und sorgst dafür, dass Anzeige, Botschaft und Landingpage zusammenpassen.

  • SEO und Content: Du steuerst Agentur, Freelancer und Gastautoren, planst Themen und Ratgeberartikel und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Inhalte technisch und inhaltlich sauber ranken. Longform-Content denkst du von Anfang an so, dass daraus Shorts, Reels und Ads entstehen.

  • Creatives: Du konzipierst Ads, Hooks und Skripte und drehst einfache Formate mit unseren Gründern. Schnitt und Postproduktion laufen AI-gestützt oder über Freelancer. Du musst kein Videoprofi sein, aber ein gutes Auge für das haben, was in Ads performt.

  • Newsletter und Lead Nurturing: Unser E-Mail-Marketing läuft bereits. Du entwickelst Segmentierung, Automationen und Inhalte entlang der gesamten Investor Journey weiter, inklusive Reaktivierung bestehender Leads.

  • Daten und Tracking: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem CRM (HubSpot) und unserem Marketing-Dashboard, hältst das Tracking sauber und machst sichtbar, welche Maßnahmen tatsächlich Investoren bringen.

  • Brand: Du ziehst unsere Brand konsequent durch alle Touchpoints, von Ads über Social Media bis zu Investorenmaterialien.

  • AI-First: Du arbeitest AI-first, bei Creatives, Schnitt, Artikeln, Reporting und Automatisierung. Was manuell nicht sein muss, wird es bei dir auch nicht. Das Budget für die passenden Tools stellen wir, welche das sind, entscheidest du.

  • Perspektive: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und bist von Tag eins für die Zahlen verantwortlich. Mit wachsendem Erfolg steuerst du dein eigenes Team an Freelancern, Agenturen und Werkstudenten.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance- oder Growth-Marketing in einem Startup oder Scale-up und einen Proven Track Record: Kampagnen, Kanäle oder Funnels, die du messbar aufgebaut oder skaliert hast

  • Du bist hands-on in Paid Social und Paid Search und hast Erfahrung mit Landingpage- und Funnel-Testing. SEO und E-Mail-Marketing kennst du gut genug, um Agenturen und Freelancer zu steuern

  • Du denkst in Funnel-Kennzahlen: CPL, CTR, Conversion Rate und Lead-Qualität sind für dich Werkzeuge, keine Buzzwords. Du setzt Tests sauber auf, wertest sie aus und ziehst Konsequenzen

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Hooks, Creatives und Storytelling und weißt, was auf Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn und Instagram funktioniert. Eigene Erfahrung mit Kamera und Schnitt ist ein Plus, keine Voraussetzung

  • Du arbeitest dich sehr schnell tief in erneuerbare Energien, Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und die steuerliche Logik unserer Investments ein. Nur wer das Produkt versteht, kann dafür Marketing machen, das Investoren überzeugt

  • Du arbeitest AI-first: AI-Tools sind für dich in Content-Produktion, Auswertung und Automatisierung fester Teil des Workflows

  • Du arbeitest mit hoher Autonomie, triffst Entscheidungen selbst und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse, auch wenn es unbequem wird

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und ein sicheres Gespür für Sprache und Tonalität

  • Du bist verfügbar für eine Vollzeitstelle und bereit, an 5 Tagen pro Woche in unserem Berliner Büro zu arbeiten

  • Bonus: Erfahrung im Marketing für Finanz- oder Investmentprodukte oder in erneuerbaren Energien, oder du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera

Benefits

  • Ownership und Impact: Du baust das Marketing von Sunpeak Capital von Anfang an mit auf, arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern und hast prägenden Einfluss darauf, wie wir am Markt wahrgenommen werden

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Top Leistung wird bei uns auch adäquat bezahlt**.**

  • Kostenfreie Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft: Power dich nach der Arbeit aus beim Sport.

  • Modernes Office in Berlin Mitte: Kaffee in Barista-Qualität, Designer-Möbel und technisches Top-Setup (Apple Hardware + XXL Screens).

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events: Gemeinsame Team Abende und unser jährliches Offsite stärken das Miteinander und machen die Zeit bei uns noch besser.

  • Bezahlte Lunches: Wir sorgen für dein leibliches Wohl.

  • Workation: Anfang 2027 reisen wir gemeinsam für 2 Wochen nach Kapstadt.

Über uns

Sunpeak Capital entstand aus der gemeinsamen Vision von Konstantin und Jan. Vor der Gründung waren sie die ersten beiden Mitarbeiter des Fintech-Scale-ups Cloover, welches PV-Anlagen finanziert. Für dieses bauten sie den deutschen Markt auf und skalierten und das Partnernetzwerk auf über 200 Installationsbetriebe. In dieser Zeit erkannten sie, welches Potenzial entsteht, wenn man Kapital gezielt in nachhaltige Energieprojekte lenkt.

Anfang 2025 gründeten sie dann Sunpeak Capital - vollständig gebootstrapped und bereits nach zwei Monaten profitabel. Ihr Antrieb: die Mechanismen des Kapitalmarkts nutzen, um den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien zu beschleunigen und Investoren echte Rendite mit echtem Impact zu ermöglichen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Consultant cybersécurité - ASM / EASM
jobs.description:
U.NEAT est une société spécialisée en cybersécurité et propose des services d’expertises à travers ses pôles :

  • Expertises : assistance technique SecOps / DevSecOps

  • Consulting : activités de conseil en SSI / GRC

  • Cyber Defense Center : service SOC managé et CSIRT

Vos missions

Chez l’un de nos clients, au sein d'une équipe sécurité, vous interviendrez sur les activités ASM/EASM, avec une attention particulière à la sécurité DNS.

Vous démarrez par un état des lieux, vous construisez la feuille de route avec le management sécurité, puis vous la mettez en œuvre avec les équipes techniques.

  • Faire l’état des lieux : processus existants (RACI), outillage utilisé, zones insuffisamment couvertes

  • Construire et faire valider la feuille de route : objectif, étapes, livrables et plus-value sécurité de chacun, validés par le management sécurité

  • Fiabiliser le référentiel des actifs exposés : exploiter et optimiser l’ASM pour découvrir domaines, sous-domaines et services exposés, et tenir ce référentiel à jour

  • Automatiser l’analyse d’impact : évaluer la criticité de chaque détection en croisant données techniques, dépendances et contexte métier

  • Prioriser et piloter les remédiations : classer les risques selon l’exposition, l’exploitabilité et l’impact, accompagner les équipes techniques et vérifier que les corrections sont effectives

  • Mesurer : définir et faire évoluer les indicateurs de risque et d’efficacité des remédiations

Das hilft (kein Muss)

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Application Engineer to be the primary technical partner for customers adopting our innovative liquid cooling products.

You will work directly with enterprise customers and our engineering team, translating real-world system requirements into deployment-ready solutions. This role requires sharp technical insight combined with exceptional communication to build strong partnerships. You will ensure our technology delivers clear and measurable performance benefits to our customers, directly contributing to the scaling of our high-performance solutions in complex thermal environments.

About apheros:

We are a startup pioneering metal foam-based cooling solutions for AI-data centers and more. Our materials are integrated into cooling solutions for both single and two-phase direct-to-chip liquid cooling - enabling better performance, hotspot management, and energy savings.

Our team is built on curiosity, collaboration, and a shared drive to craft a sustainable future - while having fun along the way! Our offices, labs, and pilot line are close to the train station in Baden, Switzerland, and fully stocked with coffee and cake.

Tasks

  • Be the primary pre-sale technical lead for customers adopting our liquid cooling solutions, engaging deeply with the data center hardware ecosystem to understand detailed thermal and fluidic requirements
  • Develop compelling technical use cases for our customers, as well as performance models that clearly highlight the value, efficiency, and Return on Investment (ROI) of our cooling solutions
  • Drive proof-of-concept demonstrations and performance validations, showcasing how our solutions meet stringent thermal, fluidic, and operational requirements
  • Collaborate closely with internal R&D and Engineering teams to ensure critical customer insights — spanning materials, thermal science, and high-performance computing needs — are accurately translated into product development
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships, acting as a trusted technical advisor who partners with clients to optimize their thermal performance and overall data center efficiency

Requirements

  • 3- to 5-year experience as an application engineer, solutions engineer, or pre-sales role, specifically within data center, high-performance computing (HPC), or thermal management environments
  • A strong technical understanding of liquid cooling systems and data center cooling requirements
  • Excellent customer‑facing skills with a proven ability to build rapport and trust with engineers, systems architects, and executive decision‑makers
  • The ability to translate customer application needs and requirements into clear, concise inputs for our Product Development and Engineering teams
  • A pragmatic, collaborative, and adaptable mindset comfortable thriving in a fast-paced, startup environment focused on clear, measurable results

What sets you apart:

  • You possess an advanced technical understanding (or degree) in thermal management, fluid dynamics, or data center infrastructure, enabling in-depth discussions about complex liquid cooling solutions
  • You have a proven track record in technical sales - ideally in electronics hardware, HPC, or data center environments - with experience in driving customer adoption and leading technical sale cycles
  • You genuinely care about customers’ pain points and translate them into concrete, fast-to-deploy cooling solutions
  • You can work fluidly across R&D, Engineering, Product, and Marketing functions to achieve collective goals

Benefits

  • High autonomy to drive product strategy and make a direct, meaningful impact on the company's trajectory and bottom line
  • Complete technical ownership of cooling solutions, from initial customer concept and design to successful deployment and post-sales validation
  • A commitment to mutual support, continuous learning, and direct, constructive feedback to help you develop and grow with the company
  • Flexible work arrangements supporting work-life balance

At apheros AG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and fields of expertise.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'd be part of a diverse group of both technically and business minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers.  Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet management and maintenance strategies, global asset management, system integrations, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful Sales Engineer at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.  

This is a unique opportunity to support and grow a key market for Samsara in close collaboration with other areas of the business: Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Technical Support, and Customer Success.

This role can be office-based (Paris) or fully remote in France. This role requires travel up to 25% of the time.

In this role, you will: 

  • Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.
  • Articulate to prospects how businesses like theirs use Samsara today to solve problems common to their industry.

  • Open the door for deeper entrenchment into accounts (integration, upsell, cross-sell) by becoming a consultant to your customers.
  • Act as a liaison between Samsara's product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.
  • Partner with sales executives to plan, prepare, and execute transactions in rapid sales cycles.
  • Work in multiple levels of the technology stack.
  • Support sales executives ad-hoc queries and emails.
  • Build relationships with third-party partners, such as software providers, systems integrators, and installation partners.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 4+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales, customer success, or customer/product support capacity.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders based on your technical sales acumen and a solid understanding of business processes and change management.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of MEDDIC/BANT/CoM and/or Value Selling sales concepts.
  • Previous experience managing hardware and/or software product evaluations.
  • Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems.
  • Experience with the following concepts: technical consulting, cloud software, cloud-connected hardware, computer networking, business systems integration, automation, and control systems.
  • Fluent in French and English
  • Great time management and organizational skills to work on multiple accounts and projects at different stages.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Work experience in task automation scripting and transferring data between systems using Bash, Python, JavaScript, or equivalent language.
  • Work experience building solutions leveraging open APIs.
  • Understanding of vehicle diagnostic systems, including Controller Area Networks (CAN bus) and Power Take Off (PTO) applications.
  • Hobbyist interest in working with things driven by electronic systems (car audio installation/classic car restoration, home automation, building things with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, etc.).
  • Consistent track record of success selling complex technical solutions through strategic sales cycles.
  • Experience working with product teams internally and feature request processes.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. jobs.title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
jobs.description:
About machineMD

At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere.

We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos™ device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test.

The Role

You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.

  • Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.

  • Automation Across the System – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end-to-end scenarios beyond UI testing.

  • Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.

  • Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.

  • Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.

What We Look For

Experience

  • Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.

  • Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.

  • Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code.

  • Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.

Qualifications

  • Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.

  • Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.

  • Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration.

How You Work

  • Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. you choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.

  • Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.

  • Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn, lend a hand.

  • Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.

  • Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases.

Working at machineMD

  • Based in Bern, Switzerland, with roughly 80% of your working time on-site (approximately four days a week at full-time employment) and Monday as our shared anchor day.

  • Collaborative, in-person working, with flexibility to do your best work.

Our Four Pillars of Integrity guide how we work together:

  • Radical Responsibility: Own our choices.

  • Feeling Our Feelings: Name and honour our emotions.

  • Candor: Speak and listen with honesty.

  • Clear Agreements: Make and keep clear commitments.

Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics in a dynamic startup, let’s talk!

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why.

We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only, no recruiters please.

We’re excited to meet you!

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 £70k-£90k (negotiable)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer - the most senior individual contributor for design within a product domain. This is predominantly an IC role: you'll set the design bar for an entire domain through the quality of your own work, the patterns you contribute, and the way you raise the designers around you. We're flexible on this for the right person, if you've got management experience, or want to line-manage one or two designers alongside the IC work, let's talk.

We want someone who is tired of the "feature factory" grind, who is past needing to be told what's worth working on, and who is ready to set the design direction for a domain in one of the most exciting PropTech companies in the UK.

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. Lead Product Designers drive roadmap conversations alongside their product and engineering counterparts, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

Here's what you can expect to be working on as an L6 Lead Product Designer at Street Group

  • Own the design vision and execution for a product domain. Translate strategic direction into the most ambiguous, cross-cutting, or strategically important pieces of design work.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like in your area.

  • Own the cross-cutting design problems: patterns across multiple features, flows across multiple surfaces, the coherence of the domain's experience as a whole.

  • Mentor and raise the bar of the designers around you - through critique, pairing, and modelling what excellent design looks like.

  • Drive AI thinking strategically - both in your own workflow (Claude Code, in-product changes, prototype testing) and in what we ship to users. You'll have a strong view on what makes a good AI feature in this domain vs a gimmicky one.

Why you should (and shouldn't) apply

You should apply if:

  • You've operated at senior IC level in a modern product org and you want broader scope to influence what gets built.

  • You're commercially fluent. You've made design trade-offs informed by how the product makes money, not just by user preference. You can name those trade-offs and defend them either way.

  • You define what success looks like before you ship, and you read the result against it after. Metrics, support data, customer feedback - you go and look.

  • You have strong, well-formed views on AI in product design and have put them into practice. You can articulate when AI is the right design solution and when it isn't.

  • You move at pace on strategic work, not just on features.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role. Lead expects materially more scope, autonomy, judgment, and ownership of outcomes.

  • You've never shipped design work where you defined a success measure upfront and checked the result afterwards. We need someone who already operates that way.

  • You've never had to make a commercial trade-off - design that's user-optimal but expensive to build, or design that doesn't move retention.

  • You'd struggle to explain how AI is changing what you ship, not just how you work. AI fluency is non-negotiable at this level.

  • You expect to be handed a brief. At L6 you identify what's worth doing and bring the case for it.

A bit about you

  • Experience: Roughly 8+ years of Product/UX Design experience, with a track record at senior IC level. SaaS or complex product experience is strongly preferred.

  • Outcomes, not artefacts: You can point to design work you've shipped where you wrote the success measure upfront and read the result after release. You know what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently.

  • Commercial fluency: You understand how the products you've worked on make money and you've made trade-offs informed by that.

  • AI: Comfortable using AI across your workflow and equally comfortable thinking strategically about AI in the products you design - what makes a good AI feature, what the failure modes are, what to build now vs later.

  • Craft: Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. You have views on interaction quality, hierarchy, motion, microcopy - and you can defend them.

  • Cross-functional: Comfortable as a peer at the table with product and engineering counterparts in your domain. Drive direction; don't wait for it.

  • Open to flex: This is predominantly an IC role, but we're not rigid about it. If you've line-managed before, or want to take on one or two direct reports alongside the IC work, we're open to that conversation.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

We don't have a fixed band published for this role yet - it'll be calibrated based on your experience and scope. Please apply and let's have the conversation.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

Interview Process

4 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc a design task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder/Head of Product.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual

Compensation: £70K – £90K

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors.

About the Role

Summary

Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups.

 

We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line.

 

This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of.

Outcomes & KPIs

Key Outcome(s) Owned:

  • End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability.

  • A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window.

  • Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter.

  • Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release.

  • Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release.

  • Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding.

What You'll Do

  • Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy.

  • Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write.

  • Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release.

  • Validate before you specify. Use AI coding assistants, MCP clients, and agent runtimes hands-on to prototype and stress-test proposed behavior — so requirements are grounded in how agents actually behave, not just how they are documented to behave. Define success metrics for what you ship and track them post-release.

  • Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises. Be the trusted authority on what your part of MARS does today, what is coming, and what it deliberately does not do yet.

  • Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content.

  • Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization.

Functional Competencies

Required:

  • 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end.

  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface.

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team.

  • Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter.

  • Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually.

  • Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is.

  • Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations.

  • Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material.

Preferred / Nice to Have:

  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it.

  • Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform.

  • Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers.

  • Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security.

  • Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls.

  • Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction.

  • Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Menlo Mindsets

The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success.

  • Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You receive strategic direction, not a task list — and you are expected to decide what your surfaces should build next, act on it, and keep the Head of Product and your partners informed as you go.

  • Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same.

    • What it looks like in this role: You publish an honest competitive point of view, including where MARS currently trails, and you keep documentation that clearly separates what ships today from what is planned so the field never over-promises.

  • United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes.

  • Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development.

  • Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value.

    • What it looks like in this role: You sit in customer and prospect conversations regularly, support live technical evaluations, and carry what you hear straight back into requirements rather than filing it away as research.

About Menlo Security

Menlo Security's mission: Enabling humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely without compromise. Menlo Security's patented Isolation platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by eliminating the threat of malware from the web, documents, and email. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies, to protect their most important asset — their data — and is backed by top-tier investors.

Our Compensation and Benefits

At Menlo Security, Base Salary is one part of our competitive total compensation and benefits package and is determined using a salary range. The base salary range for this role is [Pay Range].

In accordance with NY, CO, CA, and WA law, the range provided is Menlo Security’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. Menlo Security is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Why Menlo?

At Menlo, we don't settle for the status quo — in our technology or our culture. How we think and act is just as important as what we build. Our culture is defined by five core mindsets: Proactive Leadership, Straight Talk, United Impact, Elevated Talent, and Customer-Compelled. We take ownership and drive outcomes without waiting to be told. We communicate directly and seek hard truths. We break down silos and win together. We hold a high bar for ourselves and the people around us. And we treat every customer interaction as mission-critical. If you're someone who sees it, owns it, solves it, and does it — you'll thrive here.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Senior Data Collection Operator (FR)
jobs.description:
About Genesis

We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake.

We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers.

The role

General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too.

You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area.

You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows.

What we are looking for

  • You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment.

jobs.description:

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.

  • Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

  • Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

  • CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

  • Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.

  • Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.

  • Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

  • Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).

  • Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions N2F et Keeple s’imposent comme des références sur le marché français.

N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), et Keeple centralise la gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail) le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile).

Missions principales :

  • Conception et développement de solutions IA en Python.

  • Mise en place de pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pour améliorer la pertinence des modèles,

  • Intégration d’outils IA et d’orchestration (N8N, OpenAI, Claude, …),

  • Veille technologique sur les innovations IA et proposition d’idées/concepts pour enrichir nos produits,

  • Collaboration avec les équipes produit, data et dev pour industrialiser des solutions IA fiables et scalables.

Compétences techniques attendues :

  • Maîtrise du langage Python.

  • Expérience sur AWS (idéalement Bedrock, Lambda, S3, etc.),

  • Bonne culture des APIs IA (OpenAI, Claude, etc.).

C’est un plus si :

  • Première expérience en mise en production de solutions IA/LLM

  • Connaissances avancées en LLM et techniques de prompting,

  • Pratique du RAG et des architectures de recherche de données contextuelles,

  • Familiarité avec des outils d’orchestration et d’automatisation (ex. N8N),


Soft skills :

  • Force de proposition : capable de transformer la veille technologique en solutions concrètes,

  • Curiosité et capacité à vulgariser l’IA pour des profils non techniques.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience confirmée (3 à 5 ans minimum) en développement logiciel (si possible sur des projets IA)

  • Expérience dans un contexte cloud (idéalement AWS),

Ce que ce poste n’est PAS :

  • de la data science (pas de modélisation statistique, pas d’entraînement de modèles maison),

  • un poste MLOps centré sur l’infrastructure ou la gestion de clusters,

Ce poste est bel et bien un rôle de développeur(se) logiciel : il s’agit de concevoir, intégrer et industrialiser des fonctionnalités IA directement dans nos produits SaaS. Tech, pragmatique, orienté production.

jobs.title: Front Office Stagiaire
jobs.description:
Als Front Office Stagiaire ben je het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze gasten! Wanneer zij voor het eerst het hotel binnenkomen geef jij ze een warm welkom in het hotel en help je bij het inchecken. Meelopen naar de kamer? Leuke dingen om te doen in de stad of lekkere restaurantjes om te eten? Voor jou is geen vraag te veel! Door jou ontbreekt het onze gasten aan niets als ze bij ons verblijven en wanneer zij uitchecken gaan zij met een grote glimlach de deur uit. Ook leer je tijdens de stage meer over de administratieve handelingen en verwerk je binnenkomende reserveringen. Tijdens jouw stage leer jij over soepel draaiende Front Office afdeling, en alles wat daarbij verder komt kijken.

Door de dynamische werkomgeving is elke dag anders, en dat is nou nét wat deze stage zo leuk maakt. Hoe verschillend je dagen ook zijn, één ding blijft altijd hetzelfde; jij zorgt dat elke gast met een tevreden gevoel naar huis gaat. En jij zelf natuurlijk ook! Kan jij onze gasten een onvergetelijk verblijf geven?

LEONARDO HOTEL PAPENDRECHT

Vlakbij de Drechtsteden, met de natuur binnen handbereik, vind je Leonardo Hotel Papendrecht. Leonardo Hotel Papendrecht kent 87 moderne kamers en 10 volledig uitgeruste appartementen van ongeveer 100 m2. Ons hotel is het enige hotel in de Alblasserwaard en kent een klein, maar heel hecht team! Onze gasten hebben de mogelijkheid om Dordrecht en Rotterdam te bezoeken met de waterbus, over de Maas langs alle havens. Na een dagje sightseeing, een bezoek aan de Erasmusbrug of de bekende molens van Kinderdijk, kunnen onze gasten genieten van een heerlijke diner bij Chef’s! Food & Drinks. Deel jij jouw favoriete uitjes met onze gasten? 


WIE BEN JIJ?

  • Jij bent op zoek naar een stage die aansluit bij jouw (hotel)opleiding.

  • Hospitality zit in jouw bloed en je hebt een passie voor het vak.

  • Samenwerken doe jij graag! Je bent een echte team-player.

  • Jij bent flexibel beschikbaar en onregelmatig werken vind jij geen probleem.

  • Jij beschikt goede kennis over de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Deze stage is beschikbaar per 4 januari 2027.

WAT KRIJG JIJ VAN ONS (NAAST EEN FIJN TEAM NATUURLIJK)?

  • Als MBO student ontvang jij een stagevergoeding gebaseerd op €750,- bruto per maand fulltime, die bestaat uit €670,- stagevergoeding en €80,- onkostenvergoeding. Wij hanteren variabele betalingsperiodes van 4 of 5 weken per keer, volgens het aantal gewerkte dagen en gewerkte uren. Dus de ene maand krijg je wat minder en de andere maand wat meer.

  • Ben jij opzoek naar een (bij)baan voor tijdens of na jouw studie? Dan ben je bij ons aan het goede adres! Wij bieden goede doorgroeimogelijkheden.

  • Gek op korting? “See the world” met onze wereldwijde kortingsregeling!

jobs.title: Senior HR Adviseur
jobs.description:
Maak impact op HR, organisatie en medewerkers

Wil jij als Senior HR Advisor complexe HR-vraagstukken vertalen naar praktisch en toekomstgericht HR-beleid? En krijg je energie van adviseren, verbeteren én zelf de handen uit de mouwen steken?

Bij Priva werk je nauw samen met onze HR Business Partners, HR Director en HR Operations-collega's. Je bent een ervaren sparringpartner voor het HR-team en de business en draagt bij aan complexe HR-casuïstiek, organisatieontwikkeling en strategische HR-projecten.

Je combineert een brede HR-expertise met een praktische aanpak. Van arbeidsrecht en verzuim tot HR-processen, beleid, data en systemen: jij weet wat er nodig is om onze HR-dienstverlening continu te verbeteren.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior HR Advisor:

  • adviseer je over complexe HR-vraagstukken, arbeidsrecht, verzuim, arbeidsvoorwaarden en organisatieveranderingen;

  • ondersteun je HR Business Partners en management bij individuele en collectieve HR-casuïstiek;

  • draag je bij aan strategische HR-projecten rondom onder andere cultuur, organisatieontwikkeling, transformatie en HR-beleid;

  • vertaal je HR-strategie en wet- en regelgeving naar duidelijke en werkbare processen en oplossingen;

  • werk je samen met HR Operations aan een professionele en efficiënte HR-dienstverlening;

  • analyseer en verbeter je HR-processen en systemen;

  • zet je HR-data en technologie in om betere beslissingen en procesverbeteringen mogelijk te maken;

  • werk je actief met HR-systemen zoals AFAS en kijk je verder dan alleen de gebruikerskant om processen slimmer in te richten.

Wie ben jij? 

Je bent een ervaren HR-professional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie, advies en uitvoering. Je hebt een stevige inhoudelijke HR-basis, maar kijkt tegelijkertijd verder: waar kunnen processen beter, welke impact heeft een verandering op de organisatie en wat hebben managers en medewerkers nodig?

Je bent kritisch wanneer dat nodig is, praktisch wanneer het kan en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in veranderingen.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld HRM, Human Resource Management, Bedrijfskunde of Arbeidsrecht;

  • circa 2 tot 6 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bijvoorbeeld als Senior HR Advisor, HR Adviseur of in een vergelijkbare brede HR-rol;

  • gedegen kennis van het Nederlandse arbeidsrecht en sociale wetgeving;

  • ervaring met complexe HR-casuïstiek, zoals verzuim, reorganisaties en arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • ervaring met strategische HR-projecten, beleidsontwikkeling of organisatieverandering;

  • het vermogen om strategisch te adviseren én betrokken te blijven bij de operationele HR-praktijk;

  • affiniteit met HR-technologie, HR-data, AFAS en procesoptimalisatie;

  • uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • beschikbaarheid van 32 tot 40 uur per week.

Wat bieden wij?
In cijfers:

  • Een bruto salaris tussen €4.000,00 en €5.000,00 o.b.v. 40 uur per week (op basis van je ervaring);

  • Een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé vinden wij belangrijk: 30 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om meer bij te kopen;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

Voor je eigen duurzaamheid:

  • Maak gratis en onbeperkt gebruik van onze eigen sportruimte "The Box" op de Priva Campus, met diverse lessen in bijvoorbeeld CrossFit, Pilates en Spinning;

  • Deelname aan de pensioenregeling van Priva;

  • Opleidingsmogelijkheden via onze eigen Priva Academy.

Klaar om jouw HR-expertise in te zetten én écht invloed te hebben op hoe we HR binnen Priva verder ontwikkelen? Breng je strategische blik, praktische aanpak en verbetermentaliteit mee en bouw samen met ons aan een HR-organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.

Solliciteer als Senior HR Advisor en maak het verschil vanaf dag één.

jobs.title: Interim Senior Consultant Strategy & Transformation
jobs.description:
Freelance | Hybrid, Netherlands | Interim, immediate start 

Riverflex supports technology leaders at major organisations, and we're looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join us on an interim basis. You'll work within a Riverflex team, alongside our in-house consultants and reporting into a Riverflex project lead. The client will know you as part of the Riverflex team, not as a standalone contractor. 

Current opportunity 

A leading European retailer is merging its regional technology departments. You'll work with the leadership team that reports to the CTO to shape, document and drive the convergence plan. That includes team changes, the case for funding and how the plan is communicated across the organisation.  

We're looking for a strong communicator with a top-tier consulting background. You'll pull ideas out of senior people's heads, structure them and turn them into a clear story. You also need to challenge the thinking so the message gets sharper. This is a strategy and storytelling role, not project management. 

About Riverflex 

Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018 and is now a global team of consultants helping courageous leaders drive intelligent transformation. We work across three pillars: strategy and transformation consulting, talent services, and AI products. www.riverflex.com

What you'll do 

  • You'll own a clear workstream within the wider Riverflex project, working daily with the project lead and the team and reporting on progress several times a week. 

  • You'll interview senior stakeholders and turn what you hear into a structured plan, a narrative and executive-ready materials. 

  • You'll run workshops that help client leaders agree on decisions, priorities and next steps. 

  • You'll challenge client thinking constructively, asking “what do you mean by that?” and “have you considered X?” so the final message holds up. 

  • You'll build storylines and slide decks for different audiences, from C-suite updates to communications for project teams. 

  • You'll re-plan quickly when priorities shift, and add value from week one. 

  • You'll uphold Riverflex's quality standards: your work is reviewed and joined into the wider team's deliverables before it reaches the client. 


Job requirements 

  • 5-7 years' experience, including strategy or technology consulting at an MBB or Big 4 firm, Accenture or similar 

  • Excellent PowerPoint and storytelling skills: you can turn complex, unstructured input into a sharp storyline 

  • Experience running workshops and stakeholder interviews 

  • Business change or change communications experience 

  • A collaborative, low-ego style, and comfortable working within a team and reporting into a project lead 

  • Available immediately; based in the Netherlands and able to be on site in Amsterdam around two days a week  

  • Fluent English and the right to work in the EU 

Nice to have

  • Experience with a post-merger integration or a reorganisation of technology teams 

  • Experience designing or running communications programmes 

  • Comfort using AI-enabled ways of working 

Why this role 

You'll do senior-level strategy work for a technology leadership team, with real input into the thinking from day one and the support of a Riverflex team around you. We have several engagements in progress, so strong delivery can lead to further interim work, and we're open to talking about permanent roles for the right people. 

Apply now 

Send us your CV and a short note on your most relevant experience, through Recruitee or by contacting our talent team. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to share three or more anonymised slide decks they created themselves before the interview. 

Riverflex is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on any protected characteristic. If you don't meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we'd still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Support (m/f/d) – Fully Remote
jobs.description:
Location: fully remote, work from anywhere

About what. AG

what. is a Zurich-based digital agency. We build websites, e-commerce and growth marketing for Swiss SMEs — and we’re pushing hard into AI-driven delivery, from our own Support Agent to our what. growth product. We’re a small, senior, remote team that likes to work smart and automate the repetitive parts.

About the role

Support has grown into one of our core services — service-agreement clients, our AI Support Agent, and on-demand project management. We’re looking for one person to own it end-to-end: the vision, the processes, the quality, the team and the commercials — and to push how far we can take AI in support. You turn a growing, multi-part operation into one well-led, measurable, continuously improving service.

How we work

You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class support to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we’re AI-first: we automate the repetitive parts and use AI as a core tool every day, so the team can focus on judgement and quality.


What you’ll do

  • Own Support end-to-end — set the vision, priorities and best practices, and give the function clear direction.

  • Run and level up our processes and AI — continuously improve all support processes, including our AI Support Agent; keep them documented, train the team, own security & compliance.

  • Lead the team — empower Support Managers, WordPress developers, the on-demand PM and specialists; strong ticket and incident management and a culture of continuous learning.

  • Drive quality and delivery — define and track SA quality and delivery metrics (client satisfaction, return rate, response and completion times) and report to management.

  • Be a trusted partner to key SA clients — foster up- and cross-selling and act as relationship manager; you think about their business, not just their tickets.

  • Keep an eye on budget and profitability — invoicing, contribution margin and cost-saving measures, with support from our finance team.

  • Handle continuity and crises — prepare for and manage outages and security incidents calmly.

Key & Essential Skills

  • Ideally 5+ years in support, service delivery or technical account management (digital/web agency or hosting/WordPress environment), including experience leading a small team.

  • Solid technical grasp of WordPress, hosting and uptime/security monitoring — you don’t code, but you speak the language and can steer technical work.

  • A strong process thinker genuinely excited to take our use of AI in support to the next level.

  • Commercial sense — comfortable with invoicing, budgets and contribution margin.

  • Fluent English (our working language); German is a plus but not required.

  • Comfortable with written-only communication (tickets, email, chat); this role has no phone support.

What makes you a fit

  • You take ownership and see things through.

  • You stay calm and structured under pressure — incidents and outages don’t rattle you.

  • You give honest feedback, to clients and to us.

  • You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward.

Perks

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere. (Our Seefeld office in Zurich is there if you’re local.)

  • Real responsibility and influence — and a team that has your back. See something to improve? Speak up, we’re listening.

  • Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy — results-oriented, no micromanaging.

  • A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities — e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins’ UPW event.

How to Apply

  • Apply via our website with your CV and a short intro video (2–3 min, in English or German — whichever you’re most comfortable in; e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what drew you to this role and share an example where you improved a support operation or led a team through a tough incident.

  • 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won’t be considered.
